NAME: Emma
TEXT: Meet Emma 💕 Emma is a sweet, gentle, and friendly little blue girl with a beautiful, easy-going personality. She can sometimes be a touch shy when first saying hello, but warms up quickly and soon leans in for pats and attention -showing just how people-friendly and affectionate she truly is. Emma enjoys short bursts of fun and energy. She loves to play, splash around in her shell pool, or head out for a walk, and then she’s perfectly happy to settle in for some well-earned rest time. Inside the home, she’s a dream - housetrained, calm, and content lying on her dog bed. She’s great with other dogs, gentle with kids aged 6+, cat workable (slow introductions) and has a lovely balance of being able to run around and play, then happily stop for a cuddle. Emma would suit an active family or a couple who can spend quality time with her and help her continue to thrive and grow into the loving, happy girl she already is. She has so much love to give and is ready to share it with her forever home. 🐾

NAME: Hudson
TEXT: Hudson is a striking black male Greyhound looking for a home that matches his fun yet easygoing nature. Best suited to a semi-active lifestyle, Hudson enjoys having space for zoomies and would love a secure backyard where he can stretch his long legs and play fetch — one of his favourite games. Due to his size, Hudson would be happiest in a family with older children. He’s confident and independent enough to be perfectly content as a solo dog, but he’d also be quite happy sharing his home with another canine companion. Hudson is small-dog workable and may be cat workable with a very slow, careful introduction and ongoing management. Hudson is comfortable being left alone for reasonable periods and settles well, making him a great match for a variety of households.

NAME: Pablo
TEXT: Pablo is a handsome black male Greyhound with a calm, gentle nature and beautifully relaxed body language. He walks well on lead, taking everything in his stride with patience and ease, making him a pleasure to spend time with both out and about and at home. Friendly and engaging, Pablo enjoys human company and happily joins in for a game of fetch, but he’s just as content to relax independently when things are quiet. He’s in great body condition and carries himself with an easygoing confidence that makes him a lovely companion. With the correct introductions and guidance, Pablo may be cat workable. He would suit a home looking for a well-balanced Greyhound who offers the best of both worlds — playful when invited, calm when it’s time to unwind.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: Frankie is a handsome fawn male Greyhound with a lovely balance of calm and playfulness. He’s great with other Greyhounds and walks beautifully on a loose lead, making outings relaxed and enjoyable. While he’s generally placid and easygoing, Frankie also loves a good zoom around when the mood strikes — showing off his fun, playful side. Frankie is engaging and confident with people, enjoying attention and companionship without being over-the-top. He’s cat and small-dog workable, with the right introductions and management, and would be well suited to a semi-active lifestyle. Whether it’s a gentle stroll, a quick burst of play, or lounging at home, Frankie is happy to fit in.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: If you're looking for a playful, engaged dog who is polite with other dogs and who would enjoy an active, fun life, consider adopting Rocky. Rocky is a friendly brindle boy who has experience with kids 12+. He loves a scratch behind the ear and has a confident, outgoing nature. He is a social butterfly and would enjoy being a part of family activities whether that's walks to school or going to the park. He can be excited to get going on walks so an owner who can handle a strong dog is recommended. Rocky is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jude
TEXT: ** I am currently in a foster home for Christmas, read updates below!* "Jude (AKA Jude the Dude) is a sweet, funny and friendly boy who truly just wants to hang out with his people. Jude settles in quickly and has grown confident exploring main roads, local parks, and new routines. He’s been friendly with everyone he’s met, including children and loves a calm hello and a good pat. Jude is often complimented on his handsome looks and warm, gentle nature. He’s a bit of a water baby and absolutely loves beach walks and splashing through the water. Jude has been great with dogs of all sizes, though he seems most comfortable with slightly smaller dogs. Jude walks beautifully on lead and knows his routines well. He’s a great sleeper, adores his morning walk and has learned commands like “go to your bed,” when it's time to put his collar on or when we need to leave the house without him. Jude would suit city or suburban living and would love a canine companion, though he’s also content on his own and copes well being left for longer periods. He is a stair master and can get in and out of cars fine, though he sometimes might need a helping hand. We’ve absolutely adored having Jude in our home and know he’ll bring so much love and joy to his future family." ----------------------- Jude is a sweet lad, who is suitable to live with small or big dogs. He is a confident boy who would do well in urban/city environments and would suit longer hours alone if required. He would prefer a home without stairs but could live in a unit with a lift access. This affectionate, calm boy would be a lovely match for a family with respectful children, too. Meet Jude at Western Sydney.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: *Romeo is in a foster care home in the Inner West* Foster Update: Romeo is super happy, affectionate and playful pup (no resource guarding or sleep startle observed). He is quite confident and outgoing at home. When he’s asleep he is angelic and when he is awake, he is effervescent. He has settled in quickly, he knows where his beds are and has a sleep bed and a play bed, he figured out very quickly where his toys live and how to dig the goat horn his favourite toy out of the basket. Romeo is a quick learner and has now mastered indoor and outdoor steps. He is responding to his name most of the time. His playful antics make us laugh to no end. He is happy to pass dogs on a footpath without much notice. Favourite things about him: His beautiful soulful eyes, his stunning looks, his mischievous personality, his independence and his affectionate behaviour. *Romeo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with his foster carer*

NAME: Sally
TEXT: Meet Sally – a sweetheart looking for her forever home 🐶💖 Sally is an outgoing, friendly, and affectionate girl with a truly lovely nature. She’s gentle and respectful around children aged 6+, gets along well with small dogs (Mini Groodle and Kelpie cross), and has happily ignored the household cat (after slow introductions). Sally enjoys getting out and about and walks nicely on the lead once she gets going. She has short bursts of playful energy followed by a calm, relaxed side that loves to settle. At home, she adores her soft toys and is happiest when she can snuggle up inside with her people. Sally would be a wonderful match for an active family or a couple who enjoy spending time together and can give her the love and attention she thrives on. She’s a sweet companion who wants nothing more than to be part of your world. 🐾💕

NAME: Ruby
TEXT: Meet Ruby – she just wants to be a pet! 🐾 Ruby is a happy, friendly, and easy-going young girl who’s ready to find her forever home. She loves a good run around the yard with her sister and her fox terrier friends, then is perfectly content to relax and enjoy some downtime. One of Ruby’s favourite activities is splashing around in the pool, and she’s also very comfortable around parrots and other aviary birds in the backyard. Ruby enjoys being close to her people and loves lying in the laundry or heading inside whenever she gets the chance. She’s well-socialised and used to children of all ages, including little ones as young as 3, as well as older kids and teens. Ruby would suit a family home or any household where someone has the time to spend with her and help her happy, loving nature continue to shine. With the right home, Ruby will grow into a wonderful family pet or a loyal companion dog who simply loves being part of everyday life. 💕

NAME: Arna
TEXT: Arna is a shy girl looking for a calm and nurturing family. She doesn't mind if her family go to work during the day, as she likes the opportunity to have some peace and quiet, and would make a lovely companion for a gentle, homebody family. Once she warms up she loves all things food and play, and will show off her brave side! A home without kids is best suited. A home with a yard she can retreat to when she needs to is best suited. Meet Arna at Western Sydney.

NAME: Yola
TEXT: *Yola has spent time in foster care over Xmas - update below!* "Very loving Loves the car will settle in car straight away sleeps like a log She loves her walks Over the time I had her she wasn't aggressive with her food, bed or toys She needs lots of love and affection She loves people and was super friendly with everyone she met She will make someone a very loyal loving companion We all loved her to bits" Yola is a gentle, thoughtful girl who is learning how to enjoy the comforts of pet life. Indoors, she has a lovely ability to settle for longer periods and truly appreciates a calm, cosy home environment where she can relax and feel safe. With the right guidance and understanding, she has the potential to work up to full-time hours, especially if her adopters are willing to help her ease into being left and set her up for success. Yola would thrive best in a low dog-populated area, where she can enjoy peaceful walks without feeling overwhelmed. She knows how to use stairs confidently and navigates the home environment well. While Yola can be social with other medium to large dogs, she would prefer to be the only dog in the household, where she can soak up all the love and attention. She would be best suited to a home without children, or with older, calm, and respectful children who understand how to give her space. Yola is looking for a patient, kind adopter who understands that settling into pet life is a journey and who will be rewarded with a loyal companion who truly appreciates a quiet, loving home.

NAME: George
TEXT: Handsome blue boy George is looking for a new best friend! George is an outgoing and friendly boy who just loves every single person he meets including strangers on walks! He is looking for a chilled out home and lifestyle so he can properly enjoy his retirement. A quiet house with a yard with a big comfy bed without other pets or kids to call his own is exactly what he is dreaming of. He doesn't mind spending time alone during the day making him a great match for those who work full-time hours. As long as he has a comfy bed and some yummy enrichment activities, he is happy! George loves his food and is extremely trainable - he has already mastered several cues including "down", "shake", "off" and more! This clever boy is a quick study. If you'd like to meet this one-of-a-kind boy, apply online today! George is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Meet Luna, Our sweet little greyhound who’s ready to steal your heart 💛 Small in size but big on love, this gentle soul adores pats and being close to her people once she feels comfortable. Food and toys are definite favourites—treats are the quickest way to win her over, and playtime always brings out her happy side. She may enjoy the company of other dogs and may love a canine friend to go on little adventures with. While she can be a bit shy at first, patience and kindness helps her blossom into a friendly wriggly lady. A home without children or dogs is ideal. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate Greyhound who enjoys good company, tasty snacks, and cozy moments, this special pup could be the perfect match for your home. 🐾

NAME: Sally (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Say hello to Sally—the life of the party and a greyhound full of bounce, joy, and endless fun! This playful girl loves her toys, lives for a good zoomie session, and thrives in an environment where she can stretch her long legs and let loose. Sally would love a home with a spacious yard and an active lifestyle to match her energy. She isn’t suited to homes with small animals but she’s a great match for other greyhounds or larger breeds who enjoy a good play session, pending a successful meet and greet. Sally is also a total sweetheart with people and doesn’t hold back on affection. Whether it’s leaning into a cuddle, joining in on family activities, or bringing her toy over for a game, she makes every moment fun and full of love. If you're looking for a lively, loving companion who will keep you smiling and moving, Sally might just be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Gnocchi
TEXT: Gnocchi is a friendly girl who loves to chill in a yard and prefers to spend her time outdoors when left alone. This pretty lady is a wiggly happy go lucky girl who has experience around big and small dogs. She is polite with other dogs when out and about and would make a great walking adventure buddy. She is loving and gentle, loves her training on site at the adoption centre and would do well with a family with a structured routine and even kids to dote on her, as she is super affectionate and fun loving! This pretty girl can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dasha
TEXT: Meet Dasha – the darling girl with a playful streak! Dasha is a loving, calm, and confident girl who brings just the right mix of fun and relaxation. She enjoys her morning zoomies, a walk during the day, and another burst of play in the evening – the rest of the time, she’s more than happy to lounge on the couch. She's a cuddly teddy bear! She’s great with little dogs and having a zoomie buddy or being on her own. She loves showing off, having the ball thrown to her, zooming around and playing with her toys, as much as she loves attention and snooze time. She's a great traveller and also loves her walks, being well behaved on the lead, and can be led by a 14 year old. Dasha is housetrained (she’ll let you know when she needs to go out!) . This chatty girl does have one funny quirk – a love for toilet paper – so keep your bathroom doors closed! With her loving nature and fun personality, Dasha will make a wonderful pet or companion.💘

NAME: Jake
TEXT: ** I am currently in a foster home with small dogs, stay tuned for more updates** Hey, I'm Jake! I'm a lovely and friendly boy, who gets along great with other greyhounds, happy settled alone in a crate, not to mention I'm food motivated which everyone says here at the centre makes it easy for me to learn "pet skills"! I am polite with other dogs on walks including the little dogs I see around, making me suitable for urban life. I would also be suitable in an apartment with lift access. I think I'm the perfect match for a family with children with busy lifestyles as I'm an easy going boy who takes it all in my stride! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Rambo has enjoyed his stint in foster care, his favourite hobbies include napping on the floor, asking for cuddles (and cheese), and of course exploring the neighbourhood on his daily walks. Having lived in a foster care home, he now has his ‘stairs license’ and can confidently climb several floors. Rambo has a lot of love to give, and would therefore thrive in a calm environment. While he’s very obedient and respectful, Rambo is still working on his skills of independence and improving his confidence when being left alone for longer periods of time. He would enjoy a home with a laid back type of life. Known to roach and chill out, Rambo would be an amazing addition for a laid back couple, retirees due to his gentle nature, or a work from home lifestyle, as long as he gets a couple of short toilet walks around the block. Rambo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: *I have just finished up foster care and am ready to find my perfect home!* He would suit apartment living as he spent most of the time in foster care snoozing indoors and was toilet trained in foster care. Kenneth is a sweet affectionate guy who loves playing with other dogs and would do well with a family who enjoy big playful dogs. Kenneth would suit shorter hours alone or a doggy friend/human presence to keep him company. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life but does have that fun streak. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children or another M-L doggie pal providing they're a match for his bouncy play style with other dogs. He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Solly
TEXT: Solly is a striking young man with a personality that’s equal parts energetic and laid-back. He thrives on an active lifestyle—think brisk walks, playtime, and the occasional burst of zoomies to burn off his youthful energy. After he’s had his exercise, Solly transforms into a mellow cuddle enthusiast, always ready to relax with a wagging tail and plenty of affection. Although Solly hasn’t had much experience around small dogs or cats, he didn’t seem phased by our meta cat during his visit, which is a promising sign. With a slow and careful introduction, he could comfortably live with smaller pets. His gentle nature would likely fit well into a family environment, and he also might be suited for homes with full-time workers as long as he gets his daily dose of activity. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who can keep up on walks and then happily settle down for some quality downtime, Solly might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Cashew
TEXT: Cashew is a small, smart, vibrant and cheerful girl who has lived in foster care for a few months! She has an energetic side and would do best with an active and stimulating life, she will drop the ball at your feet and loves play time and long walks. A home with a backyard to call her own would suit her best, so she can zoom and play fetch. She is pretty independent and has shown to settle and entertain herself with food puzzles, snuffle mats or her toys, so some hours alone are OK. A structured routine and someone who enjoys the company of a confident, engaged dog, would be the best fit. Someone who enjoys dog training and living a fun, full life, would love having Cashew by their side. Cashew has some experience around older children and would suit living in a family with kids, as she would keep the kids entertained and would love to be part of your daily activities. This gorgeous girl is super friendly, active and curious. She loves to run and play, chase balls and live a fun, full life, but her most favourite thing to do is play fetch - it is so much fun and an absolute delight watching her catch balls or toys in mid-air then throwing them back at you so she can go again! This adorable little girl can be adopted at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tyson
TEXT: Meet Tyson 🐾 Tyson is a handsome boy who would suit a semi-active lifestyle, enjoying a nice balance of daily walks, relaxed playtime, and plenty of downtime. He’s adaptable and easy going, making him a wonderful companion for a variety of households. He may do best with another doggo friend, as he enjoys canine company and would love a buddy to share his days with. Tyson is used to being around kids and is comfortable in a family environment, taking all the activity in stride. A true people-lover, Tyson is more than happy to receive lots of cuddles and affection. He settles quickly into new surroundings and takes changes in his stride, making the transition into a new home smooth and stress-free. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate greyhound who fits easily into family life and enjoys both activity and relaxation, Tyson could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Rosey
TEXT: Meet Rosey 🌸 Rosey is a sweet girl who would thrive in a quiet, calm household where she can feel safe and settled. She would prefer to be the only dog in the home, allowing her to relax and enjoy being the centre of attention at her own pace. While Rosey may take a little time to come out of her shell, patience is beautifully rewarded. Once she gets to know you, she reveals her affectionate side and enjoys gentle cuddles and close companionship. Beneath her soft nature is a dog with so much love to give. Rosey would be well suited as a family dog, especially with a household that understands the value of giving her time, space, and kindness as she settles in. In return, she’ll offer loyalty, warmth, and a quiet but deeply loving presence. If you’re looking for a calm, devoted companion and are happy to let a special bond grow naturally, Rosey could be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Will
TEXT: Meet Will 🐾 Will is a beautiful boy with a truly gentle soul. He’s the kind of dog who wins hearts quietly, with his calm presence and loving nature. Will enjoys a quick burst of fun—a happy zoomie or two—before settling in for a long, well-earned rest. He would be best suited to a quiet household where he can relax and feel at ease, and he’d do well with older children who understand and respect his gentle temperament. Will is comfortable around medium to large dogs and would happily share his home with another calm canine companion. Above all else, Will loves affection. Pats, cuddles, and kind attention are his absolute favourite, and he’ll soak them up with gratitude and a wagging tail. If you’re looking for a sweet, low-key greyhound who enjoys life’s simple pleasures and offers endless affection in return, Will could be the perfect fit. 💙

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Meet Poppy! 🌸 Poppy is a playful, sweet girl with a heart full of love and a spring in her step. She enjoys playtime and has been friendly with the dogs she’s met. While Poppy has been nice to small dogs whilst in our care, she can be quite exuberant and so dogs over 10kg are more her style. Once Poppy gets to know you she becomes wonderfully affectionate and fun. Poppy loves exploring the world and would be thrilled to have a walking buddy by her side. Poppy would do best in a home that gives her a bit of time to settle in, then rewards you with cuddles, companionship, and lots of happy tail wags. If you’re looking for a playful, loving dog, Poppy might just be your perfect match. 🐾

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: CURRENTLY IN FOSTER CARE! Banjo is a beautiful older gentleman with a sprinkle of grey wisdom on his cute face. At nearly 8 years old, Banjo may be entering his golden years, but don’t let that fool you—he’s still full of life, love, and the occasional burst of playful energy. He’s a sweet, affectionate boy who adores human company and thrives on gentle attention. Banjo is happiest when he’s soaking in the quiet moments, or going on a leisurely walk. Banjo is calm, well-mannered and house trained. He is looking for a loving home where he can enjoy the simple pleasures: a soft bed and a family to call his own.

NAME: Pizza
TEXT: Meet Pizza 🍕 Pizza is a confident, happy-go-lucky boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He’s fantastic with all dogs and currently lives comfortably alongside other greyhounds, making him a great choice for a home with existing canine companions. Playful and full of life, Pizza loves to have fun and enjoys his adventures—especially when they involve travelling and exploring new places. Whether it’s a car ride, a day out, or just playtime at home, he’s always ready to be part of the action. When Pizza isn’t busy playing, he’s busy loving. He’s incredibly affectionate and well known for standing right over you, politely (or not so politely!) demanding cuddles and attention. Personal space isn’t really his thing—he’d much rather be close to his people. If you’re looking for a confident, social, and loving greyhound who will keep you smiling and ensure you never miss out on a cuddle, Pizza might just be your perfect match. 💙🐾

NAME: Blue
TEXT: Blue is a confident, character-filled greyhound who knows exactly who he is. He’s social without being over-the-top, loves a good cuddle, and then happily wanders off to do his own thing. Blue walks nicely on lead and takes everything in his stride, making him an easy and enjoyable companion. With his quietly quirky charm and laid-back independence, Blue could be well suited to a home with another large dog for company or a family who appreciates a dog with personality and balance.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a very social, affectionate greyhound with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He loves cuddles, enjoys playing with his toys, and has an endearing habit of carrying his food bowl around once he’s finished eating. Jimmy would thrive in a home with another large dog to keep him company and would benefit from having a yard to enjoy doing showing off his zoomies. Cheeky in the most lovable way, Jimmy brings fun, warmth, and plenty of smiles to those around him.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Teddy is a happy, affectionate greyhound who would thrive in an active home that enjoys getting out and about. He loves his zoomies just as much as his cuddles and will reward you with plenty of enthusiastic tail wags. Teddy would be best suited as a solo dog, as he prefers to keep his food and toys to himself. He’d make a wonderful companion for a family with older children who can match his energy and also appreciate his affectionate side.

NAME: Belle
TEXT: Belle is a super sweet, gentle greyhound with a relaxed and affectionate nature. She would suit a quiet lifestyle and could happily live in an apartment, as she’s more of a homebody than a high-energy dog. Belle would make a lovely family companion for homes with older children and could potentially live with a calm, medium to large dog. True to her breed, she’s a champion couch potato who loves lounging, short strolls, and soaking up affection.

NAME: Milla
TEXT: Meet Milla 🐾 Milla is a happy, easy-going girl with a gentle soul and a truly lovely nature. She’d be a wonderful match for a relaxed family or a couple looking for a calm, well-mannered companion. Milla is great with kids aged 9+ and enjoys peaceful walks around the streets or to the park—she’s easy on the lead and not overactive. She gets along well with medium dogs like Labradors and other greyhounds, preferring male over females. That said, Milla would be happiest as the only dog in the home, where she can soak up all the love. Milla is housetrained and good inside but prefers to be mostly outside during the day, playing in her shell pool, under the sprinkler and enjoying her toys, especially on warm days. She’s also a good traveller and is always up for adventures with her people. If you’re looking for a gentle, well-balanced dog with a sweet personality and calm energy, Milla might be the perfect addition to your life. 💕

NAME: Wren
TEXT: Wren is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who can be a bit shy at first, but once she's met you and let her come to you, her affectionate personality shines through. A few treats and a little chat go a long way with this lovely lady! She loves her morning zoomies and playtime with her retired greyhound friends, then settles in for some chill time with the family – including a small mixed-breed, a whippet, a Jack Russell, and three older greyhounds. She's well-behaved indoors and enjoys being part of the daily routine, including playing with a 2 year old girl. Wren walks beautifully on the lead and is calm and confident around town. She’s a happy, social girl who loves a gentle pat and attention. On the farm she does not worry about cows and horses nearby. Wren would make a wonderful companion in a variety of homes. She’d be happy as an only dog with someone who’s home often or works part-time from home. She’d also be delighted to share her home with a small, friendly dog, especially a whippet, and loves to lie on the lounge. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle, and loving new friend, Wren could be the perfect match for you! 💝

NAME: Noah
TEXT: Noah is a beautiful, gentle soul looking for a calm and loving home. He has a very friendly nature and greets people with quiet sweetness rather than excitement. If you’re after a relaxed companion, Noah could be your perfect match. Noah gets along wonderfully with small dogs and cats, making him a great option for multi-pet households. His calm temperament and soft manners mean he fits in easily without fuss. He’s a chilled-out boy who truly loves his comforts, especially curling up on his bed for a long, peaceful sleep. Around the house, Noah is easygoing and content to potter about or snooze the day away.

NAME: Simba
TEXT: Beautiful boy Simba is looking for a pride of his own! Simba is a sweet and gentle 3-year-old boy with a surprising playful streak that occasionally comes out when you least expect it! He is very affectionate with people, walks well on the lead and LOVES his treaties! Simba is friendly and social with both large and small dogs, and would be a good fit for a home with another dog/s or someone looking for a dog-social companion to take out and about. As a single dog, Simba has potential to slowly work up to longer hours alone. He is well behaved indoors but as he is still getting used to pet life he would also love a small outdoor space to explore and relax in. Simba's gentle nature makes him suitable for respectful kids as long as they are able to give him space when he needs a break. So if Simba makes your hear roar, apply to adopt him today! He is available from our Western Sydney kennels.

NAME: Oreo
TEXT: *DEPOSIT TAKEN* Craving some adorable love and affection? Our sweet little Oreo will hit the spot! This tiny 3-year-old boy is just about the cutest thing we've ever seen! Oreo is a happy and outgoing guy who just loves everyone - people and also other dogs as well! Oreo has shown lovely social and playful behaviour around other dogs big and small and is suitable for living with other dogs if you already have some in the family. Oreo loves his toys and respectful kids would enjoy his goofy side and also his affectionate nature. Oreo is well behaved indoors and is doing well with stairs training, making him a good candidate for apartment living. As a single dog, he has potential to slowly work up to longer hours alone, as long as he gets lots of love and attention before you leave and after you get back. Oreo can't wait to meet you! Apply online now to adopt this special little guy.

NAME: Slim
TEXT: Meet Slim! Slim is a young greyhound who has decided that the pet life is definitely for him. As a young dog, he will benefit from some ongoing training and guidance, and he is a strong, active boy who will enjoy regular exercise and mental stimulation. Slim has met small dogs and has been polite and friendly in his interactions. He has adorable lopsided ears, which certainly don’t stop him from hearing the crinkle of a biscuit packet or the jingle of a treat pouch. Slim is a real stickybeak who loves to be involved in whatever is happening around him and enjoys being part of the action. With the right home willing to invest time in his training and include him in daily life, Slim will make a fun and rewarding companion.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a friendly, playful, and affectionate male greyhound who enjoys being part of everyday life. He loves cooling off with a paddle in the pool on warm days and is always happy to jump in the car for an outing. Charlie thrives on spending time with his people and would suit a family who can include him in adventures, playtime, and fun activities. Charlie walks very well on a lead and is calm and reliable when out and about. He has confidently been walked by children aged nine years and older, making him a lovely option for a family with older kids. With his easy-going nature and love of companionship, Charlie would make a wonderful addition to the right home.

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Meet Sandy 🐾 Sandy is a young female greyhound with a happy, active personality and a playful spirit. She is full of enthusiasm and would thrive in a home that enjoys spending time with her and helping her learn the basics of everyday life. Sandy would benefit from a family who are happy to put time into some gentle training and guidance. She is eager, playful, and would love a companion who will engage with her, play games, and help her build confidence as she learns life’s basics. With patience, consistency, and plenty of affection, Sandy will grow into a wonderful and rewarding companion for an active and caring home.

NAME: Abby
TEXT: Abby is a beautiful female greyhound with a calm, gentle nature and a friendly personality. She is a very pretty girl who enjoys human company and takes life at an easy, relaxed pace. Abby has spent time around children aged 9 years and older and has even been confidently walked by them, showing her steady and trustworthy temperament. She is good with small dogs and has also met a cat, showing no reaction. With a little patience and sensible introductions, Abby could happily live in a home with a cat. Although Abby hasn’t lived in a house before, she is surprisingly well-mannered indoors. She can walk comfortably on wooden floors and is exceptionally clean and tidy, keeping her space neat and calm. Abby would suit a loving home looking for a gentle, affectionate companion who is easy to live with and ready to enjoy the comforts of family life.

NAME: Sesame
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sesame, a sweet and small sized little lady with a quiet nature. I like the calm life and simple pleasures like sniffari's and gentle walks. I settle nicely on my own and could suit full time workers with a house or apartment due to my laid back nature. My best home is one without other dogs, but happy to live with respectful children who are quiet and calm like me. I settle best indoors so a home who will let me come inside and sleep on the couch is best suited. I love calm interactions and people who will nurture me and teach me all about pet life. Meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: River
TEXT: * ON HOLD * River is a sweet, affectionate girl who would suit apartment living with lift access, or a home with another dog big or small. River is calm, highly affectionate and cuddly, and would love a nurturing and calm home to enjoy the spoils of pet life. Her favourite thing is coming into our GAP office and finding the comfiest dog bed possible and sleeping ALLLLLL day. River is gentle with all people or dogs and would be suitable to live with respectful children. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Mason
TEXT: Playful and vibrant Mason is ready to find his forever home! This adorable 3-year-old boy is small in size but big in personality! Mason has an outgoing and affectionate personality and loves to become instant best friends with every person he meets! He loves tossing his toys around and is best known for his trademark hilarious zoomies! Mason is a well-rounded boy who would suit a variety of different homes. He is friendly and social with other dogs around his size and would gladly share his home with one. However, Mason is also quite happy in his own company and be fine to live as a single dog spending a few hours alone during the day. Older/respectful kids are also suitable and would enjoy Mason's silly side. Although he would love a backyard or courtyard to zoom in as he pleases, it is not essential if you have an active lifestyle and would enjoy taking Mason outside regularly to have some fun. So get ready to bring some joy into your home and heart with our goofy guy Mason! He is ready when you are.

NAME: Spark
TEXT: Introducing Spark the handsome brindle greyhound. Spark has been around teenage kids and acts gently around them. He loves playing with soccer balls in the yard and would do best with a slow introduction to walks as a new pet as he can become overwhelmed with new places. He has been described as loving and quirky - your quintessential greyhound! Spark would be suitable with a female dog companion, a house with a backyard and would enjoy being a family member with indoor/outdoor access. Spark is available to adopt from Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Tessa
TEXT: **Tessa is available via a foster care arrangement at Western Sydney - if you think you're a perfect match to foster and look after our special girl Tessa please reach out to Western Sydney** The Western Sydney team are delighted to put forward Tessa as a suitable greyhound for the right foster care home. Tessa has been our office dog here at the adoption centre. Tessa's perfect home is a home with no children, no stairs, and a house with a backyard. When it comes to other pets, Tessa has shown sociability with cats and small dogs so a home with polite existing pets could be an option pending a discussion with the rehoming team. Tessa is a very affectionate and loving girl who loves to ask for lots of pats then settle herself nice and comfy in her bed next to you. She is playful, polite, and dorky when she plays with toys! She is happy spending the day alone and would suit longer stints of hours alone. When Tessa was our beloved office dog, she was known to enjoy spending quiet time indoors snuggled up on her bed, for almost all day, sometimes you'd forget she was there! Enrichment activities such Licky-Mats and Kongs are a hit with Tessa and are a great way to bond with her. Tessa is a stunning girl looking for a family to foster her and provide her the care she needs - could it be you?

NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Meet Bobby! Bobby is a stunning black greyhound with a gentle soul and a heart full of love. This handsome boy is friendly and easygoing, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loyal friend. Booby is a happy go lucky chap. He enjoys life’s simple pleasures—paddling in water on a sunny day, hopping in the car for a drive, and spending time with his furry friends. Bobby currently shares his home with a cheeky little dachshund and gets along beautifully. He’s also a social butterfly when it comes to other dogs, loving every opportunity to mingle and make new pals. Quiet and tidy in his space, Bobby is as low-maintenance as he is charming. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who will bring joy and calm to your life, Bobby is ready to steal your heart.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Gus is a sweet and charming guy who has short bursts of energy, can be a little shy, with an overall adorably friendly nature. He is polite on the lead and walks perfectly next to you on adventures. He will keep his diary full of fun things like snoozing, adventures like sniffing the yard, playing with the kids, and snoozing on the couch. This sweet guy is friendly around medium to large dogs, enjoys a quick game of fetch, and is gentle, friendly and soft with all he meets. Gus is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ella
TEXT: Ella has grown up around small dogs like poodles/cavoodles, and would suit a home with another dog big or small. She gets along with greyhounds too, making her a great fit for a multi-dog home or someone looking to take her to family events with other dogs. She can be nervous when she is first getting to know you but warms up and shows her loving personality in no time. She loves a clam shell pool in the summer time, so a house with a backyard with room for her own kiddy pool would be great this Summer! She has been described as playful, placid and calm. Ella is fond of toys and balls and will love a fun active lifestyle with her new family.

NAME: Minnie
TEXT: Minnie is a sweet, bubbly girl. Minnie is friendly, affectionate, a tad goofy, and oh so lovable! Minnie is a great blend of silly and calm, being middle aged she's ready to kick off her lounge lizard era, and can't wait to meet you! A home with a yard to perfect her zoomies, and some children to entertain her after school, would be a great fit. In return Minnie promises to keep everyone upbeat and having fun every day. She can be nervous in new places so a family who are happy to take it slow to begin with would be a great fit. This gorgeous girl can be adopted at Western Sydney.

NAME: Girl
TEXT: Hi, I'm Girl! I'm young, cute, and looking for a new family. I can be shy in new places but I promise to be a big brave girl once I become a member of your family. Due to being a bit nervous, older children would be best suited for me. A home with a place to retreat would be the best, as I learn to thrive along side you, so a house with a yard or my own room would be really great! I am friendly with other dogs and show a cute little tail wag, showing off my brave side. I'm still young so a family who can train me and teach me all about the world would be amazing! Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ellie
TEXT: Introducing Sweet little Ellie! Ellie can be a little shy at first with new people, but with some patience and love you will soon see her affectionate and goofy playful sides come out! Ellie love her treats and her toys and we have found it to be a super rewarding experience to win her over! She may even delight you with her spontaneous joyful zoomies (that last approximately 7 seconds before she needs a nap). Ellie would suit a relaxed and laid back home and lifestyle and would love a backyard or courtyard to call her own. She is happy to share her home with another medium-large dog, or could spend a few hours chilling alone during the day as a single dog. Older, respectful kids/teens are suitable, provided they can give Ellie space when she needs a break. If you think you can give Ellie the loving home she deserves, apply online today to adopt this sweet girl!

NAME: Tanooki
TEXT: Hey! I'm Tanooki. I'm a friendly, outgoing guy looking for a place to call home. I am affectionate, love zoomies, and would make an awesome addition for a family with fun loving children who are looking for an energetic pal. I am friendly with big and small dogs and would suit a home with a likeminded doggie pal. If you have a backyard, love the fun life and are looking for a cool guy like me, apply now! I'm available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Diva
TEXT: Diva is a stunning female greyhound who knows what she loves: food, attention, and plenty of affection! She walks beautifully on a loose lead, making strolls with her an absolute pleasure. This affectionate girl adores being the centre of attention and will happily soak up all the love you can give. Diva would prefer a calm, medium-to-large doggy friend to share her space—she’s not really a fan of the cute little dogs. If you’re looking for a sweet, loving companion who will melt your heart (and maybe sneak a snack or two), Diva is ready to rule your world!

NAME: Crackers
TEXT: Meet Crackers – and no, she’s not crackers at all! Crackers is a gorgeous greyhound with a sweet and curious personality. She’s usually calm and quiet, but she loves to be involved and keep an eye on what’s going on—she’s a bit of a sticky beak! She’s great with small dogs, adores a good pat, and is super easy to handle and walk. Crackers is the kind of girl who will happily join you for a stroll, then curl up for some well-deserved cuddles. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly greyhound who’s just the right mix of chilled and cheeky, Crackers is ready to steal your heart! “Crackers – the calm, curious companion you’ve been waiting for!”

NAME: Derek
TEXT: Hi, I'm Derek! I'm a friendly, food motivated boy who loves treats and I have even learnt things like "yes" and "down". I am great in a crate, and enjoy my apartment simulation times making me suitable to be indoors with you during the day. I would like to live in a house with a backyard and I'm even suitable for full time workers. Sometimes the big wide world can get a bit overwhelming so a bit of encouragement on walks and a slow exposure to new things would be really good for me! A home without children and staircases is ideal. Come meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Poet
TEXT: *I'm in foster care - see update below!* "He has settled in really well, he is very independent and is happy to just watch you walk around the house, definitely not a velcro dog. He is walking really good on the lead also, is not distracted by noises or other dogs." I’m Poet the greyhound, long legs, gentle soul, A champion napper with couch-warming goals. I’m living in foster, I’ve learned all the rules, Including toilet training — I’m no fool. Full-time workers, you’re speaking my style, I’ll greet you at home with a long-legged smile. I walk, I nap, I play with flair, Mostly I’m calm and happy to share. So if you’re seeking a calm, loyal friend, A story of love with a beautiful end, Come meet me soon, my chapter’s not through, I’m Poet, and I’m waiting just for you. Poet is available from Western Sydney.

NAME: Belle (Western Sydney)
TEXT: If you’re looking for a dog who will steal your heart without even trying, meet Belle. She’s affectionate, confident, and genuinely one of those dogs you wish you could keep forever ❤ Belle would love a home in a low dog-population area, ideally with experienced dog people or adopters happy to continue the great foundations she’s learned while in care. She’s picked up an awesome skill set that’s really set her up for success, and she thrives when those skills are understood and supported. Inside the home, Belle is an absolute pleasure. She settles beautifully, making her well suited to full-time work hours or apartment living, and she LOVES her crate, finding it a safe and calming space. She’s medium to large dog friendly and has been an incredible confidence-building buddy for some of the more timid dogs onsite. Belle has a special knack for helping others feel safe and relaxed around her. Belle is super affectionate, wonderfully confident, and has even shone during onsite group days, taking everything in her stride with her signature calm charm. She’s also child friendly and would enjoy being part of the family fun. Honestly, it’s hard to fault Belle. She’s the kind of dog who makes everyday life better just by being in it. We have no doubt she’s going to make a family very happy ❤

NAME: Bandit
TEXT: Meet Bandit Bandit is a handsome male greyhound with a heart as big as his soulful eyes. He’s a quiet and easy-going boy who loves a calm environment. While he may be a little shy at first, Bandit quickly warms up and shows his sweet, affectionate nature. He’s great with small dogs and knows how to share his space politely. Bandit is also polite and well-mannered with children and has been around kids aged 7 and under, making him a wonderful family companion. A clean and tidy housemate, Bandit uses a doggie door like a pro, making him low-maintenance and independent. If you’re looking for a gentle soul who will bring peace and companionship to your home, Bandit is ready to steal your heart.

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Meet Willow 🌸 Willow is a friendly, happy older girl with a gentle soul and lots of love to give. She’s had two litters in the past and plenty of handling, so she’s calm, confident, and very people-oriented. Willow is affectionate and enjoys being around her humans — she’ll happily come up to you for pats and cuddles, and loves spending time with you in the backyard or joining you on relaxed walks. She gets along with other dogs and would suit a quiet household with some attention and walks, happy with grandchildren visiting aged 6 and up. Not overly energetic, Willow is an easy-care companion who’s content just being near you and sharing your day. If you’re looking for a sweet, steady friend with a loving nature, Willow could be the perfect addition to your household. 🐾💛

NAME: Chopper
TEXT: Chopper is an absolute delight—a happy, tail-wagging boy who brings joy wherever he goes. Full of personality, he adores his toys, loves a good zoomie session, and is always ready to show off his playful side. Confident and cheerful, Chopper settles into new environments with ease and quickly becomes a bright spot in any home. While he’s a big fan of affection and will gladly soak up attention from his favourite humans, Chopper is also perfectly content to relax and enjoy some quiet time on his own. He strikes a lovely balance between being cuddly and independent. Chopper wouldn’t mind sharing his home with another medium to large dog, especially one who can match his energy and playfulness. His easygoing nature makes him a great companion for both people and dogs alike. If you’re looking for a fun-loving, confident boy who brings equal parts joy, play, and calm, Chopper might just be the perfect addition to your family. He’s ready to fill a home with tail wags, toys, and plenty of love.

NAME: Muppet
TEXT: Our goofy guy Muppet will fill your home with laughter and love! Muppet is a very friendly and outgoing boy, known for going up to every stranger he sees on walks with his wagging tail and asking for pats! He's got an adorable wiggly and playful nature, but above all he just loves getting lots of pats and attention from his people! Muppet would suit a home with at least a small yard so he can soak up the sun and play with his toys. He would prefer to be the only pet in the family and doesn't mind spending a few hours alone during the day provided you live in a quieter neighbourhood. Muppet LOVES his treats and staff here at GAP HQ find him to be very trainable! He has already learned to walk beautifully on lead, a great (on-lead) recall and to settle on his bed when asked! Muppet is suitable for older kids who would just love his playful and affectionate nature. If you think Muppet is the perfect fit, apply online today to take his sweet boy home!

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a handsome male greyhound with a heart as big as his graceful stride. He’s the perfect mix of calm and friendly. Personality: Tom is clean, quiet, and wonderfully easy-going. He loves a peaceful environment and is happiest when he can relax by your side. Temperament: Calm and affectionate, Tom enjoys gentle company and is friendly with small dogs, making him a great fit for multi-pet households. Why You’ll Love Him: His laid-back nature and sweet personality mean he’ll quickly become your best friend. Whether it’s a cozy evening indoors or a leisurely walk, Tom is always ready to share the moment. Don't miss out on this handsome boy, head out and check him out.

NAME: Dan
TEXT: Dan is a handsome 6-year-old male greyhound with a need for speed—he’s very fast and loves to run! When he’s not showing off his racing skills, Dan enjoys taking it easy and lazing around. He’s great with other dogs and relaxed around children, making him a wonderful companion for families. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly boy who loves both adventure and chill time, Dan is your guy!

NAME: Dusty
TEXT: Hi, I'm Dusty, a distinguished, gentle boy looking for a couch to call my own. I am polite with other dogs and would suit a home with a calm medium-large companion - although not essential. A house with a backyard would be perfect, as I love to sniff around and enjoy the indoor outdoor lifestyle. A home who will continue training and enrichment games would be great as I am smart and have shown I'm eager to learn. A home without children is best as I can be shy around lots of stimulus. I need a home that is calm and consistent so I can build my confidence and settle in well. Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: 💙 Meet Alfie — Your Blue Fawn Adventure Buddy! Alfie is a striking blue fawn greyhound with a bright mind and an energetic spirit. He’s eager, curious, and always ready for his next adventure — the perfect match for a family who loves to get out and explore. ✨ What Alfie is looking for: An active lifestyle: Alfie thrives with regular exercise, outings, and activities that keep both his body and mind engaged. Family home with older kids: He’d do well in a busy, loving household with children who understand dogs and enjoy being part of his fun. Canine companions: Alfie is best suited to living with a medium or large dog who can match his play style and confidence. A yard to enjoy: Space to stretch out, run, and sniff is important for this energetic boy. Lots of enrichment: Puzzle toys, training games, and new experiences help Alfie shine — he loves using his brain just as much as his legs. Alfie is ready to bring enthusiasm, affection, and excitement into the right home. If you're searching for a fun, smart companion who’ll keep life lively, Alfie could be the perfect partner for your adventures.

NAME: Enzo
TEXT: *I'm in foster care with another greyhound!* Foster Update: "Loves having a dog or human companion. Fully toilet trained and can use a doggy door. Loves playing fetch with a ball or squeaky toy. Playful and so full of joy, jumps up (but not on you, like a kangaroo) when he's excited that you're home. Loves a bum pat, and when you're sitting down he'll scooch himself over your knee like he's trying to be a lap dog. No drive towards birds or medium to large dogs. Enzo has: been to Bunnings and was very polite (except for a sneaky wee in the garden section) Mastered stairs, dog doors, staying away from electric fences, walking politely with another dog on leash Not shown any resource guarding with food or high value treats with us or Theo Not shown any signs of sleep startle Enjoyed meeting visitors and strangers for a pat in both home and outside environments" Enzo is the perfect blend of calm, playful, goofy and loving. He enjoys spending time in the office and although he tolerates the chaos of the office, he ideally would prefer a calm and quiet lifestyle. A home with a backyard in a quieter area would be best for this boy and pending a meet and greet, a home with another medium to large dog could work for him too! He has loved playing with all of his Greyhound friends and is super social with all the people he meets when he's out and about. When he is left alone, he has shown to settle quite well so could suit a home where his humans are home less often throughout the day. This adorable boy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: 🌹 Meet Rose — Your Gentle Red Brindle Beauty! Rose is a stunning red brindle greyhound with a calm, affectionate nature that wins hearts wherever she goes. With her soft eyes and gentle spirit, she’s the kind of dog who brings instant warmth to any home. ✨ What makes Rose special: Great with small dogs: Rose interacts beautifully with smaller companions, making her a wonderful fit for multi-dog households. A dream travel buddy: She settles comfortably in the car and rides like a pro — perfect for road trips, vet visits, or weekend adventures. Lovely on the lead: Rose walks with ease and elegance, enjoying her outings without pulling or fussing. Confident & comfortable: Whether she's exploring new places or relaxing at home, Rose carries herself with quiet confidence and grace. Rose is ready to bring love, loyalty, and serenity into her forever home. If you're looking for a gentle friend who’s as sweet as her name, Rose might be your perfect match.

NAME: Snag
TEXT: Snag is a handsome blue brindle boy who would suit a house with a backyard, and a home in a low dog populated area. His ideal fit would be an owner who doesn't wish to bring Snag to high dog populated areas like dog parks, doggy day care/cafes. His ideal home would be one with a couple hours alone here and there, and a family who can build him up to more. He likes being indoors when it's hot so the ability to be indoors and outdoors is a must. This gorgeous boy would mingle nicely with children 10+. Snag is on the small size for a male greyhound, too. Snag is a gorgeous boy and we can't wait to see which lucky family gets to take him home. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Griffin
TEXT: Griffin is a big gentle giant. He would do best with a family who have experience with shy dogs. He is slowly learning about the world around him and does well with slow exposure to new things - walks, new places, new stimulus. He has shown to settle well on his own for a few hours and could build up to longer hours with a backyard in a quiet neighbourhood. He mingles nicely with the other greys at the centre and would enjoy a home with a medium-large dog with a similar nature to him. He would be suitable for children, preferably older kids as he is large in size. He is very sweet when you get to know him and will play a game of fetch with you. Griffin is a very sweet dog and would make a wonderful pet for a family lucky enough to adopt him. Griffin is at Western Sydney.

NAME: Cody
TEXT: Meet Cody – Your Gentle, Energetic Gentleman Cody is a handsome fawn male greyhound with a loving nature and a wonderfully balanced energy level. He’s a big boy with an even bigger heart, always ready to greet the day with a joyful morning run-around. After that, he’s content to relax and spend most of the day snoozing happily. He enjoys a play session or a nice walk later in the day, making him a great match for people who like a bit of activity without constant high energy. Cody isn’t overexcitable—just cheerful, affectionate, and easy to live with. He would suit workers, a couple, or a family with older kids who can give him love, routine, and a comfy bed to stretch out on. Cody is ready to bring warmth, fun, and companionship to his forever home. If you're looking for a gentle soul with a playful streak, Cody might just be your perfect match. 🐾💛

NAME: Beau
TEXT: *Beau has just gone to foster care for the holidays* Beau is a charming, gentle guy looking a couch to call his own. Beau would love a home whether that's an apartment or house with yard. His calm and gentle nature makes him suitable for many home types whether that's with respectful children or with a homebody family looking for a laid back pet. Beau is very sweet with other dogs as well making him a suitable match for a home with another calm likeminded medium to large dog. His calm, sweet and adaptable nature will see him thrive in a nurturing home where he can learn to be a pet at his own pace. Meet Beau at Western Sydney.

NAME: Lady
TEXT: Meet Lady — the sweetest girl with a heart as warm as her smile! This friendly, calm and lovely-natured sweetheart wins everyone over with her gentle spirit. She’s wonderful with people and is gentle with kids 8+. Lady walks beautifully on lead, loves her daily adventures, and is always up for a stroll, a splash in her backyard shell pool, or a good swim. She’s been inside with no concerns and would suit most households looking for a well-mannered, affectionate companion. Lady is easy to have around, well behaved, and happiest when she’s included in your daily life. And her fun fact? She adores Vegemite on toast — her favourite special treat! If you’re looking for a loving, calm & gentle soul to join your home, Lady might just be your perfect match. 🌟🐾

NAME: Patch
TEXT: Gentle giant Patch is a stunning greyhound with a gorgeous white and brindle coat that turns heads wherever he goes. He’s a big, gentle soul who loves being part of the action and will happily soak up all the attention you can give. His calm nature and affectionate personality make him the perfect companion for someone looking for a loyal friend. Patch enjoys relaxing in cozy spots, but he’s also up for playtime and walks. He’s looking for a loving home where he can stretch out, feel safe, and share his big heart with his new family. Why you’ll love Patch: Striking white and brindle coat Gentle and affectionate temperament Big dog with an even bigger heart If you’re ready to welcome a beautiful, loving companion into your life, Patch is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Ollie
TEXT: Friendly, playful, and full of charm Ollie is a sweet and sociable greyhound who loves making new friends—both human and canine! He’s playful without being over-the-top, and his gentle nature makes him a joy to be around. One of Ollie’s cutest quirks? When he gets excited, he likes to “nibble” your hands with his nose—a little affectionate nudge that will melt your heart. He’s looking for a loving home where he can enjoy cozy naps, fun play sessions, and plenty of attention. Ollie would thrive with someone who appreciates his affectionate personality and is ready to share lots of cuddles. Why you’ll love Ollie: Calm yet playful temperament Loves people and enjoys gentle interaction Unique and adorable habit of nudging hands when happy If you’re ready to welcome a loyal companion who will brighten your days, Ollie is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Jumbo
TEXT: ** I am currently in a foster home for Christmas, stay tuned for more updates** Hi, I'm Jumbo! I'm a very handsome boy, looking for a place to call home. I love all of my human friends and I like to show off my confidence meeting new people when I'm out and about. I love going on outdoor adventures and I enjoy my daily walks too...oh and did I mention I'm a stair master? I wouldn't mind two story home or a place that needs to be go up and down a few stairs. I could potentionally go home with another medium to large breed sibling, pending a meet and greet. I also loooove treats and have been responding very well to my training. Could I be the guy you're looking for? Come and meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: Stunner
TEXT: Stunner is stunning (hence the name), she lives in a rural environment around native and domestic animals and has always had young kids in her life. She is keen on playing with toys and walks well on the lead.

NAME: Bev
TEXT: Bev is a lovely girl who lives in a rural setting. She lives amongst domestic animals and has no shortage of roos, wombats, echidnas and birds coming past.

NAME: Focus
TEXT: Focus is very focused on lounging around. She is a special low maintenance sweetheart that is great with kids and is very sweet and affectionate.

NAME: Fiama
TEXT: This special girl loves getting outside just so she can soak up the sun. She knows her name well and is good when left alone in the yard. She has grown up around kids and plays well with the other greyhounds.

NAME: Linda
TEXT: Linda is a friendly relaxed girl, she will come out for a stretch and sticky beck in the paddock and will soon put herself back to bed. She has farm and native animals living in her space and is not bothered meeting the cats at the house.

NAME: Star
TEXT: Star likes playing in the yard with the other hounds. She is surrounded by farm animals and has the natives passing by often. She has no problems being left on her own.

NAME: Jellybean
TEXT: This girl is extremely friendly and affectionate. She is happy to be on her own and also likes your company, she is laid back and friendly and happy to go with the flow. She lives around native and domestic animals.

NAME: Milur Lou
TEXT: This special girl is everybody's friend, she is resilient and laid back. She is happy to play and stretch her legs. She lives around farm and native animals and shares her space with other hounds.

NAME: Sophie
TEXT: Hi I'm Sophie, a happy adorable cuddly girl! I have tested nicely with dogs big and small and would enjoy a home with another dog to keep me entertained. I have met children and been upbeat and well behaved. I'm energetic, fun and would love kids to play with. Due to my bouncy nature, older kids/kids with dog experience is best suited as I am known to jump into your lap for cuddles! A house with a backyard would suit me best as I have some energy to burn! Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Hamish
TEXT: Hi, I'm Hamish, a gorgeous blue fawn boy. I can walk up and down stairs, and loves a snuggle once I get to know you! I have been described as calm and well behaved, with a lovely nature. I'm a great traveller and would be happy to settle in the car for road trips. I'm calm and a bit playful around other dogs and would suit a home with another dog my size/medium to large size. Meet me at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Bluey
TEXT: Meet Blue – A Soft-Hearted Soul Looking for a Peaceful Home Blue is a tender, gentle boy with a calm nature and a loving heart. He takes comfort in quiet environments and blossoms when surrounded by people who understand his sensitivity. Blue would do best in a serene home with children who can respect boundaries and move at his pace. With patience, kindness, and a little space to settle in, he’ll form deep bonds and become a beautifully loyal companion. If you’re looking for a sweet, soft-natured greyhound who just wants a peaceful place to call home, Blue might be the perfect match. 💙🐾

NAME: Shelly
TEXT: 📄 Meet Shelly – The Gentle Blue Fawn Sweetheart Shelly is a soft, timid little soul who wins hearts with her quiet charm and gentle nature. She takes the world at her own pace, preferring calm reassurance and a peaceful environment where she can feel safe and supported. This lovely girl would thrive in a family home with older children or with an older couple who understand her need for a slower, softer introduction to new things. Shelly could also make a wonderful apartment companion, as she’s not demanding and enjoys a tranquil routine. She’s comfortable living with other pets—she just needs her canine companions to be calm and respectful of her sensitive personality.

NAME: Lizzy
TEXT: Lizzy s a gorgeous 9-year-old fawn greyhound who proves that age is just a number—she’s young at heart and full of love! Gentle on the lead and easy to walk, Lizzy is the perfect companion for relaxed strolls and cozy afternoons. She comes with foster experience, so she’s already familiar with home life and knows how to settle in beautifully. Her calm, affectionate nature makes her an ideal match for anyone looking for a sweet, loyal friend who loves snuggles and companionship. If you’re searching for a gentle soul who will bring warmth and joy to your home, Bindi is ready to make your heart her forever home.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Meet Our Black-and-White Beauty - Charlies Angel AKA Angel This fun-loving young greyhound is full of energy and charm! With her striking black-and-white coat and playful personality, she’s sure to steal hearts wherever she goes. She’s active and loves to run, play, and explore, making her the perfect companion for someone who enjoys an adventurous lifestyle. Despite her zest for life, she’s also sweet and affectionate, always ready for a cuddle after a day of fun. If you’re looking for a social, spirited, and loving friend to brighten your days, this gorgeous girl is ready to join your family!

NAME: Elsa (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Do you wanna build a snowman? or perhaps a bond to last a lifetime? MEET ELSA! At first, this sweet girl can be a little quiet, think “gentle snowfall,” not a blizzard but give her a moment and she’ll reveal a warm, affectionate personality that shines brighter than a frozen palace at sunrise. Elsa may have just three legs, but don’t worry, she gets around beautifully, and what she lacks in limbs she more than makes up for with love, charm, and an irresistible sparkle. She’s proof that being a little different just makes you more magical. ✨ Because she needs space to move comfortably and confidently, Elsa would be happiest as the one and only royal in her castle. A home without stairs is ideal too, so she can glide gracefully without having to conquer any mountains (even if she could, she shouldn’t have to!). If you’re ready to welcome a princess with courage, charm, and a heart as warm as summer, Elsa is ready to choose you. ❄️💙

NAME: Wilma
TEXT: Wilma is ready to find a place to call home! This sweet girl can be a little shy at first, but with a chance to warm up, she'll be your Bestie in no time! Wilma gets along not only with her Greyhound mates, but smaller dogs too. Pending a meet and greet, she wouldn't mind sharing her new home with one or two other canine companions. Wilma also responds well to her name and travels well! If you think Wilma could be the one for you, meet her at Western Sydney!

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Bernie is a laid-back legend who loves car rides and walks! He’s great on the lead and enjoys taking life at a relaxed pace. While he might be a little shy at first, Bernie warms up quickly and will soon be your loyal mate. He’s easy-going, chilled, and gets along with all dogs—making him the perfect companion for a calm and happy home. “Bernie – Your easy-going adventure buddy!”

NAME: Elsa
TEXT: Meet Elsa, a confident and upbeat canine companion who's ready to bring a touch of joy and warmth to your life. Elsa's cheerful and friendly nature makes her a delight to be around. Elsa has met small dogs and was polite and friendly. She serves as a wonderful role model, showing off her confident demeanor and spreading her joy, particularly to her sister Anna. When Anna is feeling unsure, Elsa is right there to give her the confidence she needs. Elsa comes alive during playtime, shedding any shyness as she relates to those around her. Her caring, lively personality make her a perfect match for a household with small dogs or a family looking for a devoted and joyful four-legged friend. With Elsa by your side, you can expect a life filled with adventure, companionship, and endless affection for all members of the family. Whether sharing a sunny afternoon on the lawn or snuggling together after a long day, Elsa is eager to be a part of your life. Will you be the lucky family to welcome this radiant, lovable dog into your home?

NAME: Anna
TEXT: Meet Anna, a sweet and gentle soul who's looking for a kind-hearted family to welcome her into their lives. Despite her quiet and shy demeanor, Anna has a heart full of love once she feels comfortable in her surroundings. She finds security and confidence when she’s with her sister, suggesting that another friendly canine companion might help her continue to come out of her shell. Anna is the kind of dog who will appreciate a calm and understanding household, where her quiet nature can truly shine. Her gentle disposition brings a serene energy into the home, and with time, her shy exterior will reveal a wonderfully sweet and affectionate personality. If you're seeking a loyal and devoted friend who is eager to bond and bloom in a loving environment, Anna could be the perfect addition to your family. With patience and companionship, Anna promises to be a loyal, loving, and rewarding presence in your life.

NAME: Ben
TEXT: Ben is currently in a home with a small dog and cat. Ben is a big boy who is suitable around smaller animals and children who have experience with large dogs. With proper introductions and their own spaces to retreat to, Ben could join a home with another robust dog of any size, and can live alongside your feline friends. Ben is a confident and outgoing, social boy who loves all the human friends he has made throughout his journey. He thrives on interaction, whether that’s zooming around the yard, showing off his toy collection, or soaking up some love from his favourite humans. Ben loves his treats and is eager to please, so teaching him new tricks will be a breeze! If you’re looking for a big greyhound with lots of love and energy, with a cheerful energy, and endless affection, Ben might just be the perfect fit. Come meet him at Western Sydney!

NAME: Craze
TEXT: This sweetheart is happy to focus on herself and stay in her own lane. She has lived around cats for the last couple of years along with other dogs and a mixture of random animals that she sees around the property. She is great with kids and would suit a laid back style of life.

NAME: Breeze
TEXT: Breeze can be a cheeky funny girl who is great company, she loves playing with toys and is a social, playful character when she is in the large yard with the other hounds. She live around native and domestic animals.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Grace is a lovely girl who has been living in a rural setting around domestic and native animals. Although she lives around wide open spaces this girl loves her bed and would rather lounge around through the day.

NAME: Bucket
TEXT: This pretty girl is great sharing her space with other hounds, she is playful and fun, she likes toys. She lives in an area surrounded by native and farm animals.

NAME: Opal (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Opal has zest for life that can be paralleled by none! He is a very friendly and affectionate boy, and loves just loves everyone he meets! His outgoing personality has made him a fan favourite here at GAP HQ. Opal would love a backyard to call his own and would do best in a quieter area so he can live his best chilled out life. Respectful children are suitable, however Opal would prefer to be the only pet in the household so he can soak up all the love and attention for himself. Shorter hours are preferred while he settles in, a human presence during the day will help him feel his best - from home workers or retirees would be his perfect match! So come on down down and excavate this precious and valuable Opal today! Submit an application to take him home. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: ~ Meet Bonnie! ~ Bonnie is a friendly, happy go lucky girl looking for a place to call home. This adventurous girl enjoys going down to the river for a swim and getting out and about on walks. She has experience around children, where she enjoys walks, play and pats from her smaller human friends. Bonnie gets along well with other Greyhounds, so pending a meet and greet, may find her forever home with another medium to large canine companion. With access to a backyard for toileting, occasional zoomies or catching some afternoon rays, Bonnie has proven to excel at pet life and can't wait to bring lots of love and fun into her new home! Meet Bonnie at Western Sydney!

NAME: Archer
TEXT: Archer is an affectionate, friendly boy searching for a forever home filled with love, snuggles, and good company. 💛🐾 Archer loves people and joining his humans for walks, garden playtime, and fun car-ride adventures. He’s also gentle and loving with kids 6+ and will happily play chase in the yard before coming back for pats - his absolute favorite thing! He's easy going and doesn't need long walks; a quick zoomie and play in the yard is enough some days for workers. He's ok on his own, or good with gentle small dogs. He settles beautifully in a crate and is learning to be a calm inside dog with great house manners. Archer is a sweet soul who wants nothing more than to be with his people. He would thrive with a family or someone who’s home often and looking for a loyal companion. If you’re searching for a gentle, devoted best friend, Archer is your guy. 💕🐶

NAME: Pint
TEXT: Meet Pint — your new little pocket rocket of joy! 🚀🐶 This sweet young girl is full of energy, enthusiasm, and heart. She may greet you with a bit of nervous excitement at first, but it doesn’t take long for her true personality to shine through. Pint loves people, wants to please, and quickly settles in for cuddles once she knows she’s safe. Pats? Yes please! Pint is happiest when she’s by your side—whether it’s heading out for a walk, hopping in the car for an adventure, or snoozing near your desk while you work. She’s spent time in an office environment meeting new people and handled it like a champ. She also does well with small dogs and enjoys friendly company. If you’re looking for a cheerful, affectionate companion who’s ready to join you on life’s adventures, Pint is the perfect match. She would suit an active couple or family with older kids, who have time to spend with her and nurture her. She's pretty, sweet and does flop on the grass to rest when she's had her walk or playtime - you’ll fall in love in an instant! 💛🐾

NAME: Flossy
TEXT: Flossy is a beautiful greyhound who’s nearly 9 years young and still full of grace. She’s the perfect mix of calm and affectionate, making her an ideal companion for someone looking for a loving, easygoing friend. Personality: Flossy is gentle, sweet-natured, and loves being part of a family. She enjoys quiet moments and will happily curl up beside you for a snooze. Compatibility: She gets along well with other dogs, so she’d fit perfectly into a multi-pet household. Lifestyle: Flossy is past her racing days and prefers a relaxed pace. A comfy bed, a few short walks, and plenty of cuddles are all she needs to thrive.

NAME: Benny (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Benny🐾🐶 Benny is a bright, joyful greyhound with a heart as big as his smile. Affectionate and people-oriented, he adores spending time with children and is wonderfully gentle with them. His calm, steady nature makes him a fantastic family companion. This charming boy is also a dream to take anywhere—Benny travels beautifully in vehicles and is a relaxed passenger on any outing. On walks, he’s a pleasure to handle, strolling politely on the lead and enjoying every chance to explore the world around him. Benny gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and loves having canine friends to share his adventures. He would suit be a singular pet or in a household with another M/L pup. His happy, exuberant personality shines through in everything he does, and he’s always ready to offer affection, snuggles, and a wagging tail. If you’re looking for a sweet, dependable, and joyful companion, Benny might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Astro is a heart-melting, affectionate boy looking for a forever home full of love, snuggles, and good company. While he's great with dogs of all sizes, he requires a home without another dog in the home but would thrive with doggy play dates and group walkies. He settles well in a crate and has shown to know his name and learning recall. This sweet soul is very cuddly and affectionate – a true Velcro dog who wants to be near his people. Whether it's curling up on the couch, following you around the house, or gently resting his head on your lap, Astro’s love knows no bounds. He’s a great inside dog with lovely house manners, making him a perfect match for someone who is home more often than not. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who gives as much love as he gets, Astro is your guy. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Otto
TEXT: Hi, I'm Otto! I am a friend to all big and small, so if you have a home with another dog I'd love to meet them. I love food and would do well with ongoing training as I am super friendly and eager to please you. I am great indoors and would suit longer hours left alone due to my calm and easy going nature. I am nice on the lead and would enjoy going on trots around the block. I am a very sweet boy and can't wait to meet you! You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! A sweet guy, looking for his forever home 💕 Charlie is confident and polite on lead, making every walk a pleasure. He may come across as a little quiet at first, but you’ll see just how quickly he warms up with a bit of time. Charlie doesn't mind hanging out with his Greyhound mates, so pending a meet and greet he could potentially join a home with another medium to large dog. Charlie also loves treats, making him a great candidate for some extra training in his new home. Charlie might be your perfect match! Meet him at Western Sydney🐾

NAME: Milo (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I've just gone into a foster home! Stay tuned for updates* Hi, I'm Milo. I love to get pats and will contort myself into weird positions to get all those good scratches! The team effortlessly fell in love with me when I first arrived here.
