I could suit longer hours left alone once I build up a good routine as I have been shown to be easy going and laid back during alone times. I am very friendly and think my happy nature would suit children. I am an engaging, charismatic boy who still knows how to have a good time. I love to play bow and have my silly moments, but I am overall relaxed and can't wait to snooze in a sunny spot at your place. I like settling inside a crate and would suit an apartment home with lift access. I'm a polite boy with other greyhounds and would happily join a family with another dog my size at home. I am gentle on the lead and I still love playing with toys! I hope you're interested in meeting me! I'm available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Swipper
TEXT: Snipper is a great young hound with no intention of being anything other than a loving companion. He is very friendly and affectionate, especially around little people.

NAME: Paula
TEXT: Paula is a charming happy girl who is currently friends with American staffies and chihuahua's. Paula walks nicely on the lead and has a stunning personality! She is soft and gentle around other dogs and would be suitable to live in a multi-dog household. She's been good with kids and would love a backyard to explore during the day while you're gone. A doggy pal will help teach her about your routine! We can't wait to see Paula become your new best friend!

NAME: Lady
TEXT: Lady is a vibrant girl with a fun loving personality. She is confident, excitable and bouncy. We would recommend older kids/teens as her best fit. She would love an active, engaged family who can include her in daily activities and keep her busy during the day. She would benefit from a family who can continue dog training and foundational pet skills with her. Lady is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper is a cute girl who loves to hug you! She will jump and ask for a cuddle. She loves travelling and going on adventures and having fun. She is excitable around dogs so a friendly tolerant dog her size would be suitable for Pepper. She is confident and loving and can't wait to find her forever family! She is a lot of fun and would love a backyard and even children to keep her entertained! Meet Pepper at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Lizzie
TEXT: *I'm in foster care, updates to come!* Lizzie is a shy, gentle girl who is friendly with people once she's warmed up to you. She loves soft toys, knows her name, travels well and generally sleeps for the ride! This gentle girl is soft and polite around other dogs, making her a lovely companion for someone looking for a laid back companion for their dog. She is more confident around other dogs and would benefit from a calm, relaxed home with a nurturing and understanding nature. Meet Lizzie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Warnie
TEXT: This handsome boy is great with kids and loves meeting new people. He lives well in the backyard and is very social with other dogs. He is currently living in a suburban area with family that work fulltime hours. He is good clean boy and loves keeping you company.

NAME: Apollo
TEXT: Apollo is a calculated sweetheart, he is very composed and polite. He likes to play with toys and enjoys a walk. He loves a cuddle and is super affectionate. He is a very content well balanced boy.

NAME: Ruby
TEXT: Ruby is a curious, affectionate girl. She has her energetic side where she will zoom around and chase toys, then she has her lazy affectionate side. She is good with other dogs and is comfortable on her own.

NAME: Bishop
TEXT: Bishop is a well balanced boy. He is very funny and lovable, and wont leave many dull moments in his presence. He is also very sweet and affectionate> He loves a walk and he loves to lounge around afterwards.

NAME: Panda
TEXT: Panda is a very tidy dog who is easy to train and fit in. He is confident and very affectionate. He loves to play and loves to wipe out and relax by your side. He is comfortable on his own which would make him suitable for fulltime workers or a busy family

NAME: Busta
TEXT: Busta is a great boy who loves to keep you company and hang out. He is a good walker on the lead and likes everyone he meets. He is friendly and social with other dogs and is confident when doing new things.

NAME: Casper
TEXT: Casper gets along with everybody, he is great with kids, great with all different size and breeds of dogs he has met so far. Has been exposed to native animals. Good on his own. Has had excellent prep to be your next family member.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: This handsome blue fawn boy is great company, he is very healthy vibrant boy who enjoys a walk and is happy to look after the yard. He is good inside and happy to relax with you.

NAME: Ozzie
TEXT: This handsome young fella never raced and has always been destined for pet life. He would thrive in a family environment due to his sweet and gentle nature. He has great recall and is great looking after the yard. He relaxes well on his own and is a confident young hound.

NAME: Andy
TEXT: Meet Andy🐾 Say hello to Andy, a sweet-natured boy with a heart as big as his beautiful brown eyes. Andy is the perfect blend of independence and affection — happy to do his own thing, but always ready for a cuddle or a gentle pat when you’re nearby. Andy is fantastic with dogs of all shapes and sizes and absolutely adores children, making him the ideal addition to a family home. He’s a calm and confident traveller who settles easily in the car, and he walks beautifully on the lead — no pulling, just relaxed strolls at your side. When he’s not enjoying a walk or some quiet company, Andy is perfectly content to entertain himself in the yard, watching the world go by or lounging in the sunshine. He’s an easy-going boy who takes life in stride and brings a lovely, peaceful energy wherever he goes. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion who’s as happy snuggling on the couch as he is exploring the outdoors, Andy is your guy.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Hi, I'm Charlie, a pretty little lady who can't wait to be your new best mate. I walk nicely on the lead and I'm learning to be confident in new places. A slow introduction to the big wide world will suit me best, but I know you'll help me be brave! I am very sweet and would suit a home with a dog my size and older kids who can show me all about play time and treats. Meet me by appointment from Western Sydney.

NAME: Shak
TEXT: Shak is what we affectionatly call a BFG (Big Friendly Giant). He is a big boy who is super affectionate, and he's a greyhound who sees everyone as his friend! He is confident, charming and has a lovely personable nature which we all love. This beautiful boy would be suited to family life, outings and spending time playing with older children due to his size. He'd love a backyard to zoom around and if you're home more often than not at the start of his adoption journey, we think he'd thrive and settle in well! Shak can be adopted via appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bugsy
TEXT: Meet Bugsy🌼 Say hello to Bugsy, a gorgeous, easy going greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, affectionate nature. Bugsy is the kind of dog who takes everything in stride — relaxed, friendly, and happiest when surrounded by good company. She’s wonderful with dogs, cats, and children, and currently lives peacefully with a cheeky Jack Russell and her best friend, fellow greyhound Ivy. Bugsy and Ivy share a very special bond — they’ve grown up together and are truly inseparable. Where one goes, the other isn’t far behind! They bring out the best in each other and would love to find a forever home side by side. Bugsy has a beautifully gentle and calm temperament. She’s affectionate without being demanding, loves her cuddles and pats, and is always up for a quiet walk or a lazy afternoon nap. She’s the kind of dog who fits seamlessly into family life — content to simply be near her people and enjoy their company. With her sweet, steady personality, Bugsy is the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loyal, low-maintenance friend. Together with Ivy, she’ll bring warmth, peace, and double the love to her new home. 💛 If you’re searching for a pair of calm, loving greyhounds who get along beautifully with everyone — from other pets to kids — Bugsy and Ivy are ready to fill your heart (and your couch!) with joy. See Ivy's profile : https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/ivy-7

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Meet Ivy🐾 Say hello to Ivy, a beautiful, gentle girl with a calm and loving nature. She’s the kind of girl who quietly wins your heart with her sweetness and soft eyes. Ivy is wonderful with cats, dogs, and children, and she’s already lived happily alongside a lively Jack Russell and her best mate, a fellow greyhound named Bugsy. Ivy and Bugsy are a bonded pair, which means they share a very special friendship. They’ve grown up together and take comfort in each other’s company — whether they’re lounging side by side, exploring the garden, or curling up for an afternoon nap. Where you find one, you’ll find the other close by! Ivy can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once she’s settled and knows she’s safe, her gentle personality shines through. She has a wonderfully calm, easy going nature and loves the simple things in life — a quiet walk, a soft bed, and the company of her friends. She’s polite, affectionate, and happiest when surrounded by those she trusts. Bugsy is her steady companion and a bit more confident, which helps Ivy feel secure in new situations. Together, they make a perfectly balanced team — calm, friendly, and full of love to share. Ivy and Bugsy are looking for a loving home where they can stay together. They’ll bring peace, companionship, and plenty of quiet joy to their new family. If you’re searching for a pair of gentle souls who get along beautifully with everyone they meet — humans, hounds, or even cats — these two might just be the perfect match. 💚 See Bugsy's profile : https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/bugsy

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Meet Ivy🌿 Lovely Ivy is a sweet, soft-natured lady who’s ready to find her place in the world. She’s already had a taste of home life and knows all about the comforts of a cozy couch and a quiet corner to nap in. Ivy currently lives happily with other dogs and really enjoys their company — she’s a calm, easy going companion who loves to “cruise” alongside her canine friends. She takes her time to get to know new people and situations, but once she’s settled, her gentle personality truly shines. Because she’s a little shy at first, Ivy would really benefit from foster care — a patient, loving environment where she can build confidence at her own pace, even with a friendly dog or two to show her the ropes. If you’re looking for a quiet sweetheart who gets along beautifully with other pups and will reward your kindness with quiet devotion, Ivy might be your perfect match. 💚

NAME: Flo
TEXT: Meet Flo🐾 Say hello to Flo, a bright, bubbly greyhound with a heart full of joy and a love for life! Having already spent time in a home environment, Flo knows all about the comforts of pet life — soft beds, friendly faces, and a good routine. She’s now ready to bring her cheerful personality into a new forever home. Flo currently lives with other greyhounds and gets along beautifully with them. She’s also fantastic with other dogs of all shapes and sizes, always polite and friendly in her interactions. Her easy going nature makes her a wonderful companion for multi-dog households or a great new friend for anyone looking to add a sociable greyhound to their family. This lovely girl is naturally happy, outgoing, and full of charm. She enjoys being part of the action, whether it’s going for walks, playing in the garden, or simply following her humans around the house. Flo truly thrives on human company — she loves being near people, soaking up attention, and sharing in whatever’s happening around her. One of Flo’s best traits is how well she settles into new environments. She takes change in her stride and quickly makes herself at home, adapting to new routines and surroundings with confidence and ease. Whether it’s a busy household or a quieter home, Flo’s laid-back yet cheerful attitude helps her fit right in. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate, and adaptable greyhound who will bring happiness and warmth wherever she goes, Flo is your girl. With her sunny nature and loving heart, she’s sure to make every day brighter. 💛

NAME: Aussie
TEXT: Say hello to Aussie! 🐾 Aussie is a handsome 4-year-old black boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for people. If there’s a pat going, Aussie’s first in line — he never says no to some quality human affection! He’s a dream to have around: walks beautifully on the lead, travels well, and has a calm, social nature that makes him great company wherever he goes. The handsome gentleman is more than happy to entertain himself in the backyard or curl up with you on the couch. He is great walking on the lead and has no issues exploring new places. Aussie gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes — small, medium, and large — and is always up for making new friends. With his gentle manners, easygoing vibe, and love for life, Aussie would make an amazing addition to almost any home. 💙

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I am super friendly and will make a sensational first impression, if I do say so myself! I am very charming and think you will just love me! I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too. I'm a good traveller, I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! I would prefer short hours alone as a solo pet and a slow intro to the big wide world as my horizons slowly expand as a pet with you. If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Brook
TEXT: Meet Brook🐾 Say hello to Brook, a beautiful, gentle lady with a heart full of love and a personality that shines wherever she goes. Brook is the kind of dog who seems to make friends everywhere — she absolutely adores other dogs and gets along wonderfully with canine companions of all shapes and sizes. Whether she’s joining in for a gentle play session or just relaxing beside them, Brook’s calm and friendly nature makes her a joy to be around. Brook has lived inside a home before, so she already understands what it means to be part of a family. She quickly settles into new environments and makes herself comfortable, as though she’s always been there. Her easy going and adaptable temperament means she takes new experiences in stride. When it comes to people, Brook is very affectionate. She loves spending time with her humans, whether that’s enjoying a gentle walk, curling up for cuddles, or simply being nearby while you go about your day. She has a soft, loving nature that makes her a wonderful fit for families with children of any age — she’s patient, kind, and always up for a little bit of love and attention. Brook is the perfect mix of playful curiosity and gentle calm. She’ll happily explore her yard or new surroundings, then find a comfy spot to rest and soak up the sunshine. Her ability to adapt, along with her affectionate spirit, means she’ll fit beautifully into almost any household. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving, and easy going companion who will bring warmth and happiness to your home, Brook is the girl for you. She’s ready to meet her forever family and share all the love she has to give!

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Meet Benny🐾 Say hello to Benny, our big-hearted greyhound with an even bigger personality! This handsome lad is full of life, energy, and affection — the perfect mix of fun and love. Benny absolutely adores people and thrives on human company. Whether he’s greeting you with a wagging tail or leaning in for pats, he’s sure to win you over in seconds. Benny would love a family with a backyard where he can stretch his long legs, zoom around, and play to his heart’s content. After playtime, he’s more than happy to flop down and relax, enjoying some quiet time — he’s quite independent when he wants to be! When it comes to other dogs, Benny can be a bit selective with male dogs, so he’d likely be happiest as the only dog in his new home (as long as he has that backyard and plenty of human love, he’ll be in heaven!). If you’re looking for a big, goofy, affectionate companion who’ll make you smile every day, Benny is your boy. He’s ready to fill your home with love, laughter, and a few joyful zoomies!

NAME: Polly
TEXT: Meet Polly! 🌸 Polly is a lovely-natured, friendly, and easy-going girl who adores human company and loves being by your side. She’s happiest when she can be part of whatever’s going on and would make a wonderful, loyal companion. She enjoys her walks, playing with her Jack Russell pals, or just pottering about with you in the yard or garden. Polly is comfortable around kids 11+ and has a calm, happy nature that makes her a joy to have around. A simple, relaxed lifestyle would suit Polly perfectly — she’d be an ideal match for a retiree or anyone looking for a gentle yet fun friend who’s happy to share both companionship and quiet time. 💛

NAME: Kay
TEXT: Kay is sweet, shy and sensitive. She is gentle on the lead and is currently quite reserved in new situations. We think this gorgeous girl will thrive in a calm, steady home, who are able to take things at her pace. An adults only (or potentially dog experienced older kids/teenagers) home would suit Kay best while she learns how to be a pet with you. She would do best in a home with a fenced yard so she can retreat when needed. She is polite around other dogs however would do best with a slow introduction to socialisation while she finds her feet as a pet. Someone who is home more often than not to help nurture Kay into a beloved family member will be the best fit for Kay. Meet our lovely Kay at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: If you're looking for a playful, engaged dog who is polite with other dogs and who would enjoy an active, fun life, consider adopting Rocky. Rocky is a friendly brindle boy who has experience with kids 12+. He loves a scratch behind the ear and has a confident, outgoing nature. He is a social butterfly and would enjoy being a part of family activities whether that's walks to school or going to the park. He can be excited to get going on walks so an owner who can handle a strong dog is recommended. Rocky is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Stella
TEXT: Meet Stella🌟 Say hello to Stella, a gorgeous greyhound with a heart as big as her smile! This social butterfly absolutely adores her canine friends and loves nothing more than a good play session with her doggy pals. Stella isn’t fazed by much — she takes everything in her stride with her calm, easy-going nature. Whether she’s out on an adventure or lounging at home, Stella is simply happy to be part of the fun. She’s a big fan of her humans too! Pats, ear rubs, and cuddles are always on her wish list, and she’ll happily follow you around or curl up at your feet once playtime is over. When she’s not making friends, Stella enjoys playing with her toys or just relaxing in a comfy spot nearby. With her affectionate personality and playful charm, she’s the perfect all-round companion. Stella’s dream home is one where she can share her days with loving humans (and maybe a furry friend or two) who will give her the love and attention she so happily returns.

NAME: Jebbers
TEXT: This boy may seem uninterested at first, however he is just careful and makes wise choices. Since being a pup he has always been careful and calculated. This boy is inquisitive and confident, he just has a quirky personality. He is good on his own and is social with other dogs.

NAME: Vern
TEXT: Vern is a gentleman who walks nicely on the lead, who is confident and happy around new people and happy to go gentle walks around the block everyday. A fenced backyard and a home who will include him in daily activities would be a great fit for him. Vern has a positive and welcoming nature which would see him suit a family with children. Meet Vern by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Billy! I'm a handsome fawn boy looking to find my perfect forever home. He is happy exploring new places and would enjoy a home with a fenced yard to call his own. He would love to be included in daily adventures like walks to and from the school pick up or spending time at the park! Billy is suitable to live with other dogs after a meet and greet. You can meet Billy at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: This handsome boy is a high energy, loving guy looking to bounce into your home. He loves a pat and a bit of attention but is also happy to do his own thing. He has a charming and personable nature who we think would get along well with children and other dogs. Meet Hank by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Affectionate boy Teddy is a sweet boy who walks gently on the lead and will greet you with a gentle tail wag. He is a calm, loving and sooky boy looking for someone to dote on him. He's easy to walk and has an easy going nature. He is friendly around other greyhounds and would suit a home with another dog. This cutie is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Friendly boy Bobby has been spending time learning about the world awaiting his forever home. This includes spending time with kids aged 1+, spending time around other breeds of dogs making him an adaptable well rounded hound, perfect for many home types! Bobby would enjoy a townhouse or backyard and his confident nature means he'd be happy living in suburbia, with children or going on daily walkies! Bobby is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Freddy
TEXT: Meet Freddie🚗 Say hello to Freddie, a happy, friendly greyhound who’s always ready for his next adventure! This handsome boy is the perfect mix of laid-back and enthusiastic — he loves meeting new people, exploring new places, and, most of all, hopping in the car for a good old-fashioned road trip. Freddie is an absolute star traveller. Whether it’s a quick ride around town or a longer journey, he settles in beautifully and enjoys watching the world go by from the back seat. He’s the ultimate co-pilot, always up for an outing and never one to say no to an adventure. When it comes to socialising, Freddie’s as easy-going as they come. He’s very friendly and happy when meeting new people — tail wagging, big smiles, and all the charm you could ask for. He also gets along wonderfully with medium and large dogs, enjoying their company and a good bit of canine social time. And if there’s one thing Freddie truly loves (besides travel and friends), it’s food! He’s wonderfully food-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze — and ensures he’s always ready for a tasty treat or two. Freddie would suit a home that enjoys getting out and about, but he’s just as content relaxing after a day’s adventure. With his friendly personality, love for life, and easy-going nature, Freddie is sure to make every day feel like a road trip worth taking.

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Meet Betty🌸 Say hello to Betty, a beautiful older girl who proves that age is just a number. This lovely lady may have a few extra grey hairs, but she’s still young at heart and full of quiet charm. Betty is the perfect mix of calm, gentle, and affectionate — a true companion dog who simply loves being near her people. Betty gets along wonderfully with cats, dogs, and children, making her an easy fit in many homes. She’s kind and patient, always taking things at her own pace, and has a gentle, steady presence that puts everyone around her at ease. While she may be a little reserved at first, Betty really shines once she’s settled into her surroundings. With a bit of time and love, her sweet personality blossoms, you’ll soon see her tail wagging, her eyes bright, and her heart open to every bit of affection that comes her way. She walks beautifully on the lead, enjoying calm strolls where she can take in the sights and smells of the world without any rush. Because of her gentle nature, Betty would be best suited to a low-key, quiet household, perhaps with an elderly couple or someone looking for a relaxed, loving companion to share peaceful days with. If you’re looking for a kind, affectionate soul who will bring warmth, comfort, and quiet joy into your life, Betty is ready to be your loyal friend and faithful shadow.

NAME: Dillan
TEXT: Meet Dillan🐾 If you’re looking for a calm, gentle companion who knows how to take life easy, look no further than Dillan. This handsome greyhound is the very definition of relaxed. Whether he’s lounging in a sunny spot or taking a leisurely stroll, Dillan does everything with an effortless cool. Dillan loves spending time with his fellow greyhounds and is always up for a friendly sniff and a bit of social time. He can be a little cautious around smaller dogs, so he’d appreciate slow, calm introductions to get comfortable. Out on walks, Dillan is a dream – he walks beautifully on the lead and takes everything in his stride. He’s food-motivated, which makes training and bonding easy, and he’s a great traveller too, settling down nicely for the ride. Dillan would suit most households looking for an easy-going companion, ideally one where he can be the only pet so he can soak up all the love and attention. If you’re ready for a life of calm cuddles, peaceful walks, and a friend who radiates zen, Dillan is your guy.

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Meet Bailey – your happy blue best mate! Bailey is a beautiful, friendly blue boy who adores kids (6+) and loves nothing more than a game of chase and plenty of pats. He’s a joyful, affectionate lad who’s sure to bring laughter, love, and warmth into his new home. Bailey gets along well with his Greyhound pals as well as smaller dog friends (like a Mini Groodle, Mini Foxy, Pug, and Kelpie x), so he’d happily share his home with another friendly dog. He’s a pretty chill chap, who loves being inside with you, is house-trained and crate-trained, and would suit a townhouse or house. Bailey is not over-energetic but loves a walk and his carrying around his squeaky toys. If you’re looking for a loving, playful and easy care chap who’s great with kids and ready to be part of a family or any household, Bailey’s your boy! 💙

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, friendly girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and gentle kids 10+, not too rambunctious, though not fazed by a 2-year-old nephew visiting, either. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has spent the last 6 months living as a pet in the house and backyard and loves to be part of the action, loves a walk and playtime in the morning then a nice rest on the couch or your bed, where she likes to reside when you go out. She would be a loving companion for a quieter household, even a townhouse or apartment. Julie also loves toys, a shell pool, sandpit and a nice bone or chew. Someone home more often than not would be perfect. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds or small dogs, even livestock across the fence. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life, even as an only dog. 💗

NAME: Adal
TEXT: Adal – A Big Hunk of Love! Adal is the sweetest, affectionate boy with a big heart and just as much love to give. He’s great with all people, always happy to see you, excitable at times and loves showering you with kisses. This easy-going lad enjoys his walks, car rides, playtime with his toys, and hanging out with his greyhound friends, as well as playing with the resident Whippet and Jack Russell. Adal isn’t a fan of storms, but he handles them well by quietly retreating to his safe spot inside on his bed or in a kennel in the garage until the weather passes. He’s not vocal, destructive, or escape-prone—he just likes to hunker down until it’s over. With his lovely nature, happy personality, and endless love to share, Adal will make a wonderful companion, especially if someone is home or close by if a storm is coming, and can be on his own or with another dog to play with. 💙 *Come meet Adal at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Bull
TEXT: Bull is a nice boy who loves, playing, loves affection, is good on the lead. He likes meeting new people and new critters on his walks and is very social and outgoing with great character. He has been getting experience coming inside. There something about Bull that you will love.

NAME: Mikey
TEXT: Mikey is a handsome hound who is comfortable to be on his own looking after things while your at work. He is very social and has been exposed to a lot of the world that some dogs may not be use to like trains, cattle, native animals and he travels well on the road. He is happy to make new friends and get out and about and like most greyhounds is happy to relax. He has had some house experience and is wonderful company.

NAME: Tiny
TEXT: Tiny is a quiet little girl who is very sweet & often shy with new people. She becomes sweet and affectionate once you get to know her. A house or townhouse in the quiet neck of the woods, with a nurturing owner, would be the best fit for Tiny. She could also live in an apartment if it's spacious/quiet with safe zones to call her own - eg baby gates and secluded spaces. A quiet home where she can settle in and thrive would be perfect for Tiny, this means a home without children and pets/dogs. She can do stairs & enjoys sleeping in a crate, however not required. She has shown she can settle for longer periods here and would suit working up to full timers. It would be amazing to see someone nurture her confidence and guide her through the world. She becomes playful, loves chasing toys around, likes treats and food, and walks nicely on the lead. She's happy to take treats and likes learning and training. Tiny is a sweet little dog who will make an amazing pet once she has settled in. If you think Tiny sounds like the right girl for you then apply to meet her today.

NAME: Beast
TEXT: Meet Beast🐾 Despite his name, Beast is just a big goofball with an even bigger heart! This happy boy has perfected the art of smiling — seriously, one look at that grin and you’ll be smitten. Add in his constantly wagging tail, and you’ve got a living, breathing happiness machine! Beast is a true socialite who adores the company of his fellow greyhounds. Whether it’s a gentle play session or a backyard zoomie, he loves being part of the gang. Toys? Don’t even get him started! Beast is a toy enthusiast — squeaky, bouncy, or chewy, he’s not picky. Watching him toss his toys around is guaranteed entertainment. He also enjoys exploring a backyard, sniffing out all the best spots, and showing off his model-like strut (with a grin, of course). Beast is crate-savvy and perfectly happy to come and go as he pleases — he treats it like his personal den where he can relax after a busy day of smiling and tail-wagging. He’s engaging, affectionate, and loves to greet everyone he meets…no one escapes a “hello” from Beast! If you’re searching for a companion who brings sunshine, smiles, and maybe a few stolen socks into your life, Beast is your guy. With his charming personality and endless enthusiasm, this not-so-beastly boy is ready to fill your home (and your heart) with joy. 💚

NAME: Sophia
TEXT: Meet Sophia – the Sweet & Sophisticated Greyhound! 🐾 Sophia is a gentle 6-year-old greyhound with a calm, easy-going nature. She’s been around kids (ages 5 & 6) who can walk and feed her, and she takes it all in stride! While she might be a little reserved at first, once she feels at home her playful, affectionate side shines through. Sophia gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes and is the perfect mix of grace and goofiness.

NAME: Ernie
TEXT: Ernie is a shy boy who has made a lot of progress at the adoption centre. He is looking for a special home who will nurture him and continue his confidence building. He requires a family willing to take things slow with him as we have here. He would thrive as a solo dog with a 1-2 adults at home, or a calm dog to keep him company. He could spend a few hours alone or longer, with a secure yard or courtyard. He is very sweet, cuddle and adorable once he trusts you (see photos of all his cuddly moments!). It will be a highly rewarding journey for whoever adopts our special boy Ernie. He loves lying on blankets in the garden, sitting in his shell pool and cuddling you once he knows you. Meet Ernie by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack🐾 Say hello to Jack, a cheerful and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to find his forever family! Jack has grown up around children and is wonderfully gentle and patient with them — he loves being part of family life and joins in with whatever’s going on, always making sure everyone is happy and safe. This lovely boy gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and enjoys having a playmate who can keep up with his energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs at times, so he’d benefit from some calm, positive socialisation to help him feel more confident with them. Jack’s playful side really shines when he’s surrounded by his toys. He loves tossing them around, chasing after them, and showing off his collection to anyone who’ll watch! Between play sessions, Jack takes his role as “family supervisor” very seriously, checking in regularly with his people to make sure all is well before settling down again with a big grin and wagging tail. With his happy, affectionate nature and gentle heart, Jack would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a fun, loving dog to share their days with. He’s full of character, always up for a bit of play, and even happier just to be near his humans. If you’re searching for a loyal, joyful friend who’ll bring laughter and love into your home, Jack is your guy. He’s ready to meet his forever family — and he can’t wait to check in with you! 💛🐶

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith🐾 💛 Say hello to Keith, a stunning boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This charming boy has grown up surrounded by children, so he’s used to family life and all the noise, laughter, and cuddles that come with it. He’s gentle and patient with kids, always happy to join in on playtime or relax nearby while they do their thing. Keith is an excellent traveller, he hops into the car with ease and settles down quietly for the ride. Whether it’s a trip to the countryside or a quick run to the shops, he’s the perfect co-pilot who loves to be part of the action. When it comes to other dogs, Keith gets along beautifully with larger breeds and enjoys having a playmate of similar size and energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs and would benefit from some gentle, supervised socialisation. True to his greyhound nature, Keith is a lovely mix of playful and laid-back. He adores his bursts of energy in the garden or at the park — chasing toys, stretching those long legs, and showing off his zoomies, but he’s just as happy curling up for a snooze on the sofa afterwards. He’s got the balance just right! Keith would suit most family environments, especially those looking for a single dog who can be the centre of attention. He thrives on affection and companionship and will reward his new family with endless loyalty, love, and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Coco
TEXT: *I've just gone into a foster home!* My foster family say: "She is now fully trained using the stairs with no aid. Coco enjoys the lightly heated shower and then getting brushed. She also enjoy eating chicken necks, cooked vegetables potatoes and pumpkin, loves cooked chicken!" Coco would love to live in a chilled out house or apartment (stairs are no problem!). She is a very cute little senior lady with an adorable greying face. She is super affectionate, totally fine to be left alone (with no accidents or distress) perfect for those working longer hours. She gets along with greyhounds and medium to large dogs. She loves a treat and will be a breeze to train! This sweet little senior lady can't wait to snooze on your couch and be treated like the princess she is. Meet Coco at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bj
TEXT: Meet BJ🐾 BJ is a wonderful male greyhound who’s great with all dogs and would fit perfectly into a home with children. He’s had positive experiences around kids before, making him a calm and gentle companion for family life. This affectionate boy absolutely loves pats and cuddles — he’s always ready to lean in for some extra love and attention. BJ also enjoys a splash in shallow water, happily cooling off and having fun when the chance arises. With his friendly nature, love for affection, and easy going temperament, BJ is a fantastic all-rounder who will bring warmth and happiness to any household. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who thrives in a family environment and gets along with everyone, BJ could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Honey
TEXT: Meet Honey🍯 Her name says it all – Honey is pure sweetness, with a playful streak that’s impossible not to love! Honey is a beautiful greyhound with a personality as sweet as her name! She’s a friendly, easy going girl who gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes, making her a lovely companion for both people and pups alike. A quiet and gentle soul at heart, Honey takes everything in her stride. She’s well used to travelling in cars and trailers, settling in comfortably wherever she goes — the perfect passenger for any adventure. Out and about, Honey can be a little strong on the lead at first, especially when she’s excited to explore, but she soon settles into a nice, steady rhythm. Once she’s in her stride, she’s a joy to walk beside. Honey also has a fun, playful side — she loves splashing about in the water and enjoys playing with her toys when she’s feeling lively. Whether it’s a gentle paddle, a game of chase, or some quiet time relaxing after a walk, Honey takes it all in her happy, calm way. With her sweet nature, gentle confidence, and love for both play and peace, Honey would make a wonderful addition to just about any home.

NAME: Rita
TEXT: Meet Rita💛 Rita is a lovely greyhound with a wonderfully relaxed outlook on life. She’s the kind of girl who takes everything in her stride — calm, content, and always happy to go with the flow. With her gentle nature and easy going temperament, Rita is a true pleasure to have around. She gets along beautifully with her fellow greyhounds and enjoys spending time with other medium and large dogs too. Whether she’s sharing a quiet snooze or having a gentle wander with her canine friends, Rita is friendly and well-mannered in every situation. Rita has that special “cruising through life” attitude — nothing seems to bother her, and she’s just as happy relaxing in the sunshine as she is joining in for a stroll or some family time. With her calm presence and kind heart, Rita would make a wonderful addition to almost any home. She’s the perfect companion for someone looking for a peaceful, loving dog who will fit effortlessly into daily life.

NAME: Rosie
TEXT: Meet Rosie🌹 Rosie is a beautiful, gentle girl with a calm and affectionate nature. She has that wonderful greyhound grace about her — peaceful, sweet, and always taking life at her own easy pace. Rosie’s gentle temperament makes her a real joy to be around, and she has quickly become a much-loved member of her foster home. Living with other greyhounds, Rosie has shown herself to be friendly and well-mannered. She enjoys the quiet companionship of her canine friends and fits seamlessly into a relaxed household routine. She hasn’t yet been tested with smaller dogs, so careful introductions would be needed if her new home includes them. Rosie is a lovely balance of sociable and independent. She enjoys being part of family life — whether that’s pottering around the house, joining in for some gentle fuss, or simply lying nearby while you go about your day. At the same time, she’s perfectly happy in her own company, often curling up for a nap in a sunny spot or settling quietly after a walk. Speaking of walks, Rosie travels beautifully in the car and is always content on journeys. She makes an excellent travel companion, calmly watching the world go by or snoozing along the way. Rosie would be happiest in a home where she can continue to enjoy a calm, loving environment — either with other greyhounds or as the centre of attention herself. She’s an easy going girl who will bring warmth, gentleness, and quiet companionship to her forever family. If you’re looking for a relaxed, affectionate friend to share peaceful days and cosy evenings with, Rosie could be the perfect match.

NAME: Violet
TEXT: Friendly, energetic and adorable girl Violet is a sweet and reserved girl to begin with but loves to play and bounce around once she gets to know you. Violet walks perfectly on the lead and is polite and friendly with other dogs her size. We think her confidence would grow if she had a doggie friend to spend her days with. A backyard or townhouse yard would be a perfect fit for Violet! Meet Violet by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Shirley
TEXT: Shirley is a sweet young girl ready to zoom into your life! Shirley would be a great fit for an active family with kids who can entertain her after school, or a young couple looking for a bubbly companion. Shirley could live with other dogs her size, and due to her young age would do best with ongoing training and exposure to the big wide world. She has a bright, bubbly personality and aims to please! She is playful, goofy and affectionate! Meet Shirley at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Angus
TEXT: Angus is friendly and playful, likes playing with toys and confident in new places. Angus is active, fun and would enjoy a active, structured life of daily walks and adventures. Someone confident with walking a strong dog is preferred as he can be excited to get going. Angus would be a great candidate to share a home with another medium to large dog pal! Meet Angus by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Daisy! I am a delightful girl, looking to be plucked and bunched in to a home I can call my very own. Daisy will blossom around other dogs as she has experience with English Staffies. I LOVE walks and promise to always greets you with a wiggly body. She would do best with older kids as she is bubbly, energetic and fun loving. If you don’t want to catch yourself saying “oopsie daisy” because you missed out on meeting this beautiful little lady, fill out an application to adopt Daisy today & mention her name in your application comments. Daisy can be picked from Western Sydney.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: *I have been in a foster care home for 6 weeks - read the update below!* "Sully is going well and has settled in and shows signs of improvement almost everyday. He is very good with children and with all types of dogs. He loves a walk and is good on the lead. On the lead he is well behaved and does not respond when other dog are walking near him. If I stop and talk with another dog walker Sully is calm and relates appropriately with other dogs. Sully loves to drive in the car and enjoys the wind in his face as he keeps his head out of the window. He loves a cuddle and pat in the morning and anytime during the day if he is awake." ------------ Hi, I’m Sully — a gentle, quiet-natured blue boy looking for my new home. I love being around my people, get along well with other dogs, and I’m perfectly happy spending time in the yard while you’re out. I also love having the freedom to wander in and out as I please. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. I like to take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and enjoy the fresh air throughout the day. I also like to sleep outside and would love a family who respects my boundaries when I’m resting or asleep. I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available now at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Sonic
TEXT: Ready to meet Sonic—the greyhound who’s not just fast but also the speediest chill master you’ll ever know? If there were an Olympic event for maximum chill, Sonic would take home the gold every time. This laid-back gentleman has mastered the art of relaxation and cruises through life like he’s on a permanent Sunday afternoon. Whether it’s sprawling out on the couch or making himself comfy in a new spot, Sonic just gets how to settle in and make any place feel like home. Sonic is the kind of dog who never rushes, never worries, and never gets ruffled. He’s the perfect blend of calm and friendly—always happy to say hello to new dog friends, no matter their size. Tiny pups? Big fluffy dogs? Sonic’s got the patience and easy-going charm to get along with them all. And families, listen up—Sonic would be a dream companion for kids! He’s gentle, tolerant, and totally cool with the hustle and bustle that comes with a lively household. Whether it’s playtime or downtime, he’s happy to join in or just hang out, soaking up the love and good vibes. If you want a mellow, sweet, and endlessly loving buddy who makes life feel a little more relaxed and a lot more fun, Sonic’s your guy. Ready to invite this cruising king of calm into your home? He’s already made himself comfy in our hearts and can’t wait to do the same with you!

NAME: Kai
TEXT: Kai is a social and confident boy, who is polite with greyhounds and very friendly with everyone he meets! He is gentle on the lead, showing off his lovely manners. He comes when called and aims to please! He likes carrying around toys, and would enjoy a backyard to frolic in during the day. Shorter hours alone are best for Kai as he learns to settle into pet life. Meet Kai at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Rousey
TEXT: Rousey is a sweet gentle girl, a bit shy and reserved at first but already warming up with us at the centre! She loves food and will happily take a treat from you. She is gentle on the lead and promises to walk nicely on the lead for you on adventures. She LOVES chin scratches, too! This lovely girl would suit a home with respectful children, and wouldn't mind sharing her home with another dog her size! Rousey is available by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Missy – The Gentle Soul Missy is a beautiful 10-year-old black greyhound whose calm presence and kind heart make her the perfect companion. With her soft eyes and graceful demeanor, she exudes warmth and serenity. Missy is gentle with everyone she meets and her sweet nature makes her a comforting couch buddy. Though she’s in her golden years, Missy still enjoys quiet strolls and cozy naps in sunny spots. She’s the kind of dog who will rest her head on your lap and make you feel like everything is right in the world. Her loyalty is unwavering, and her affection is given freely to those lucky enough to know her. Missy is more than just a pet—she’s a gentle friend, a quiet listener, and a loving presence in any home. Missy has already lived as a pet in a home and is fully toilet trained.

NAME: Zena
TEXT: Hello, I'm Zena! Zena is a happy, friendly girl, who would suit a nurturing, calm household to really thrive into the cheeky, confident girl we've seen here at the adoption centre! A home without kids would support her confidence the best. She can live with another calm dog her size but this isn't a necessity, as she really enjoys the company of her humans! Zena does best indoors in a quiet room - a house with a backyard is best suited, so Zena can have space to play and relax. This gorgeous girl has shown us her confident side by conquering our stair case all by herself! Zena's favourite activity is settling down in a cozy area while enjoying a Kong or a food puzzle, since treats are her second favourite thing! She is phenomenal with her training cues - (I know my name, how to go "down" and settle on my bed and am currently learning how to "sit"!) Zena is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: Ryan has spent time in a foster home — keep reading to find out why his foster carer loved him so much! "Ryan is a sweet, gentle soul with the calmest nature you’ll ever meet. He loves lounging near you quietly, always happy to just be in your presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, gets along well with people, and has such expressive eyes that tell you exactly how he’s feeling. He’s low-maintenance, clean, and well-behaved around the house. He enjoys short walks and long naps, and has a soft spot for comfy bedding and gentle pats. While I’ve come to care for him deeply, I’ve realised I’m not quite ready for a dog at this stage. Ryan deserves a home where he can be someone’s forever companion. He’ll make an incredible addition to any calm, loving household." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan loves his walks around the adoption centre (pictured!) — and did we mention he’s super smart? 🐾 He already knows “on your bed,” “down,” and “shake,” among plenty of other tricks he’s learned in pet training. Ryan’s waiting for his new best friends to pick him up at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre — could that be you?

NAME: Lou
TEXT: If you're looking for a friendly and outgoing companion, check out Lou! Lou has recently spent time in foster care where he mastered going to markets and meeting all the stall holders. Lou is a sweet, people-focused boy who enjoys routine, gentle companionship, and having his humans within eyesight. He walks beautifully on lead, took inner-city living in stride during foster care, and happily relaxed at cafés, pubs, and markets. He’s polite with other dogs on walks, enjoys calm play with other greyhounds, and absolutely adores squeaky toys and fetch. Lou is independent but affectionate, active in the mornings, and a cosy snoozer by evening when he has a comfortable spot to unwind. He will do best in a house with yard access, as smaller apartments made it difficult for him to fully settle and find his own space. When sharing a home with a medium–large dog, he benefits from structure around resting places and clear routines to keep everyone comfortable. Lou is a loving, joyful companion who thrives when given room to relax, predictable guidance, and a household that enjoys his mix of active playtime and peaceful downtime. Read below to see what Lou's foster carers had to say about him! "Lou is a beautiful boy with a lot of love to give. He walks very very well on the lead, ignores most birds and bush turkeys. He is not very interested in saying hi to other dogs and will respectfully walk straight past them. He loves squeaky toys with a passion and plays fetch with them with so much joy. He is a master of stairs. He would benefit from living in a house with a backyard, as our small apartment was a bit tight for him (he likes a safe space). In saying that he still wants to be within eyesight of you. He’s an independent but people loving doggie. He would benefit from an active owner - he is full of beans and loves longer walks and play time. He is most active in the mornings and is up for cuddles and play time, in the evening he likes to curl up and snooze independently." Apply now to meet Lou from our Western Sydney program.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a playful, sweet-natured boy with a cheeky streak and a big heart. He’s lived with a young cattle dog puppy and showed plenty of patience, and he currently shares his life with a couple of toddlers who climb all over him—he doesn’t mind a bit! Jack LOVES his toys (especially fetch!) and is super treat-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze. He’s all about having a good play, then flopping onto a comfy bed for a well-earned nap. Jack’s also been known to “reorganise” shoes around the house—just his way of helping with interior design! If you’re after a fun-loving, kid-friendly companion with a mischievous grin and a heart of gold, Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Burt
TEXT: Burt is a total character who thrives on human attention and isn’t shy about making sure you notice him! He can pull like a pro at first on walks, but give him a little time and he settles right down. Burt gets along with other greyhounds at home but prefers to be the king of his castle—he’s got a strong “mine” vibe when it comes to his food and toys. He’s great with kids of all ages and has plenty of experience being a patient, lovable buddy. Burt’s looking for someone who’s home most of the time to keep him company and soak up all his charm. Cats aren’t really his cup of tea, so a feline-free home would suit him best. Ready for a lively, loyal companion? Burt’s your guy!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a calm and quiet lady who walks well on lead and prefers a relaxed lifestyle—perfect for someone looking for a low-key companion. She enjoys a little play with toys now and then, plus the occasional zoomie to remind you she’s still got some pep in her step. Bertha is best suited as a solo dog and would be a wonderful match for someone who wants a peaceful friend to share their days with—especially if you work from home and can keep her company. While she’s not a fan of cats, Bertha’s easy-going nature makes her a sweet and steady companion for the right home.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: Bonnie is a sweet and social girl who walks well on lead and absolutely loves playing with toys—whether she’s teaming up with a human for some playtime or putting on a one-dog toy show all by herself. She’s great at keeping busy and thrives on affection, always ready to share cuddles and generous face licks. Bonnie is very friendly with the greyhounds she lives with and gets along wonderfully with them. While she hasn’t been around cats before, she may do well with a slow introduction to smaller dogs. If you’re looking for a playful, loving companion who’s equal parts fun and snuggles, Bonnie could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a confident, energetic guy who walks beautifully on lead and loves to bound around with enthusiasm. He’s super engaging with people and thrives on treats—perfect for training and bonding! While Jimmy enjoys playing with other greyhounds during his outings, he prefers to be the only dog in the home to keep things calm and comfortable. Jimmy hasn’t had much experience with cats and tends to prefer a pet-free feline zone, so a cat-free home would be best. Jimmy would shine in an active household where he can join in on plenty of adventures and daily fun. If you’re looking for a lively, loyal, Jimmy is your guy!

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Meet Goose – the big-hearted goofball! 🐾 Goose is a gentle boy who loves being part of whatever you’re doing—whether it’s pottering in the garden, hanging out in the shed, or going for a drive (he’s a great traveller!). He’s recently discovered the joys of indoor life—lounging on the couch or his bed with legs in the air is a favourite pastime! Goose is house-trained, sun-bakes like a pro ☀️, and also enjoys a comfy spot on the verandah or patio. Friendly with everyone he meets, Goose loves toys (especially his beloved soccer ball!), swims, and easy, sniffy walks. He’s met kids 10+ and is calm around other dogs🐶. Goose is easy-going, friendly and happy who would love a home where someone is around more often than not, easily suited to retirees to travel with or someone wanting a companion dog He’s quiet, only giving the occasional bark for more pats or when dinner’s on the way. Apart from missing two toes from an old puppy injury he still likes a walk, preferably on grass, and is a healthy, affectionate boy ready to share his big heart with you. 💙

NAME: Jacko
TEXT: Meet Jacko! Jacko is a confident, curious soul who's ready to find a forever home where he can truly shine. With a natural love for exploring the world around him, Jacko would thrive with a single person or a couple who can give him the time, space, and companionship he deserves. While Jacko adores human company, he prefers to be the only pet in the home so he can soak up all the love and attention. He may be open to meeting other dogs his size with slow, careful introductions — but he’s happiest when he has his own space to relax and play. This smart boy has fantastic recall and responds beautifully when out and about, making adventures together a real pleasure. He also enjoys his downtime with toys and will happily entertain himself or engage in a gentle game with his humans. If you're looking for a loyal, playful, and independent companion who's ready to explore life by your side, Jacko might just be your perfect match. Key Info: ✅ Best as a solo pet ✅ Confident and curious ✅ Slower intros with other dogs his size ✅ Excellent recall ✅ Loves toys and enrichment ✅ Ideal for a single person or couple Jacko is ready to meet his person – could that be you?

NAME: Shadow
TEXT: Meet Shadow 🐾 Shadow is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound who’s happiest when he’s hanging out with his human family and preferably inside, where he can find the comfiest spot in the house and make it his own. Once he’s picked his perfect chill zone, you’ll barely know he’s there… until it’s time to play or snack, that is! Shadow gets along beautifully with other dogs and adores children of all ages. He’s calm, friendly, and takes everything in his stride, making him a lovely companion for a busy family or anyone looking for a relaxed but social dog. If you’ve got a cat, Shadow may need a slow and gentle introduction—he’s curious but polite, and with a bit of patience, there’s potential for peaceful cohabitation. Despite his relaxed nature, Shadow loves to play, especially a good game of fetch! He’ll light up when you grab a toy and is always ready for some fun in the yard or a quick burst of activity before heading back to his favourite snooze spot. And when the treats come out? Oh, you’ve got his full attention. This boy knows how to sit pretty for a snack and will happily hang out just to be near you. Shadow would thrive in a loving home where he can enjoy the best of both worlds: playtime and cuddle time. Whether you’re a family with kids, a home with other dogs, or someone looking for a loyal companion to share quiet moments and light hearted play, Shadow is ready to step into your life and into your heart.

NAME: Hammer
TEXT: Ready to nail the perfect companion? Meet Hammer 🐾 Hammer is the ultimate all-rounder—a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who gets along famously with other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether it’s a tiny terrier or a big labrador, Hammer’s easy going nature means he’s ready to make friends wherever he goes. This lively boy absolutely loves his zoomies and would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can race around and let loose to his heart’s content. When he’s not zooming, Hammer is a wonderful family dog—gentle, affectionate, and great with people of all ages. He’s equally happy as a solo dog or as the perfect companion for a young couple looking for a loving, energetic friend. Hammer is a cuddler at heart and enjoys spending quiet moments snuggled up with his humans after a day of fun and play. His engaging personality and happy disposition make him a joy to be around, always eager to say hello and share some love. If you’re searching for a playful, affectionate, and well-rounded greyhound who’s ready to bring energy and warmth into your home, Hammer might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Big Boy
TEXT: Say hello to Big Boy 🐾 Big Boy is a gentle giant with a heart as big as his name! This confident and max relaxer greyhound is a true people pleaser who adores everyone—from dogs and cats to children of all ages. He’s got a warm, friendly nature that makes him an instant hit wherever he goes. While Big Boy loves socializing, he prefers to be the king of his castle and would do best as a solo dog in his forever home. That said, he’s always up for a fun doggy playdate to stretch his legs and enjoy some furry friendship time. He knows how to keep things chill and relaxed, so his play dates tend to be happy and harmonious affairs. Big Boy would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can soak up the sunshine, lounge on the grass, or explore at his own leisurely pace. He’s happiest when a family member is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys company but is also perfectly content to kick back and chill solo when needed. Whether he’s snoozing quietly or spending quality time cuddling with his humans, Big Boy’s laid-back vibe brings calm and comfort to any household. On walks, Big Boy is a star walker, calm and confident on the lead, making every outing a peaceful pleasure for both dog and human. If you’re looking for a lovable, relaxed companion who’s a true social butterfly with a preference for solo living and fun play dates, Big Boy could be your perfect match. Ready to settle in and steal your heart, he’s waiting to become the gentle giant of your family!

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Meet Jett 🐾 Jett is a confident and outgoing boy with a heart full of love and energy. He has previously lived happily with small dogs, showing his friendly and adaptable nature, and he’s always ready to make new furry friends wherever he goes. This active boy thrives on plenty of exercise and stimulation, but he also knows how to switch gears and settle in for lots of cuddles and affection. Jett absolutely loves being close to his humans and will happily snuggle up whenever he gets the chance. His affectionate nature makes him a true companion who will brighten your days with his joyful spirit. Jett would do best in a home where someone is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys having company around and thrives when he’s not left alone for long periods. His confident and sociable personality means he’s ready to explore the world and enjoy new adventures with you by his side. If you’re looking for an energetic, loving, and confident greyhound who is great with smaller dogs and adores affection, Jett could be the perfect addition to your family!

NAME: Kala
TEXT: Kala is strapping young lad who is a big cuddly softie. He just wants to be part of the family. He is happy to supervise while your working hard around the yard and is happy to fetch toys and drop them at your feet. Kala is destined to be a valued family member with a lot of love to give. Great with everyone he meets. Still needs a bit of patience and guidance to be a great companion.

NAME: Magic
TEXT: Meet Magic, a greyhound who lives up to his name—he’s full of spark, joy, and a touch of mischief! Magic is an energetic and playful boy who loves to get out and explore the world. He walks with confidence and enthusiasm, making him the perfect adventure buddy for a family that enjoys being active. Whether it’s a stroll through the park or a weekend outing, Magic brings excitement and fun wherever he goes. Magic’s outgoing nature comes with plenty of good manners—he’s polite and social with other dogs and has happily walked alongside both medium to large breeds and smaller companions without fuss. He would likely enjoy sharing a home with another greyhound or dog friend pending a meet and greet. Once he’s had time to settle and learn the comforts of home life, Magic will be content to spend some time on his own too. If you’re looking for a lively, affectionate companion who’s ready to add a little sparkle to your days, Magic might just be the perfect addition to your family

NAME: Geisha
TEXT: Say hello to Geisha 🐶 Geisha is a beautiful lady with a calm presence, a gentle spirit, and a love for life’s simple pleasures. She has the kind of soothing energy that fills a room without saying a word – just her being there makes everything feel a little more peaceful. True to her name, Geisha moves with grace and serenity, but don’t let that elegant exterior fool you – she’s also got a wonderfully playful streak! When it comes to other dogs, Geisha is a total pro. She’s incredibly dog-social and happy to live with canine companions of all shapes and sizes. Whether she’s gently playing, quietly snoozing next to them, or just sharing her space, she does it all with ease and friendliness. Geisha is what we like to call “effortlessly easy.” She’s wonderfully relaxed, low-maintenance, and happy to go with the flow. She’ll adapt to your routine without complaint and will be your quiet shadow, following you from room to room with calm curiosity. She doesn’t ask for much – just a soft bed, some gentle affection, and maybe a toy or two to keep her entertained. One of her favourite things is simply being close to her humans. She thrives on gentle affection and will happily rest her head in your lap or snuggle in close for some quiet bonding time. She’s affectionate without being needy – just a sweet, steady presence who’s always nearby when you need a bit of comfort or company. Geisha is ready to find her forever home – could it be with you?

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Meet Joe 🐾 Joe is a confident and cheerful gentleman with a tail that never stops wagging! Full of personality and charm, Joe carries himself with a happy-go-lucky attitude and a healthy dose of independence. He knows what he likes — whether it's a good sniff around the backyard or a comfy spot to lounge in, but he’s always happy to come over for a cuddle and soak up all the affection you're willing to give. Joe is great with medium and large dogs, showing good manners and a calm approach. He’s still learning about smaller dogs, so slow and gentle introductions will be key. With the right guidance, he’s a smart boy who’s always up for learning something new. This lovely lad would thrive in a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs and enjoy some solo sunbathing time. Joe’s independent streak means he’s not overly clingy, but he still loves having his humans around — especially if they’re up for some playtime or pats. He’d be best suited to a home with older children who can match his energy and give him the space he needs to relax and feel secure. If you're looking for a happy, affectionate, and self-assured greyhound to brighten your days, Joe could be just the guy for you! 🐶

NAME: Nitro
TEXT: Meet Nitro! ⚡️ Nitro is a lively guy who knows how to strike the perfect balance between zoomies and chill time. When he’s feeling energetic, he’ll happily race around the yard like a little lightning bolt, showing off his speedy moves and playful spirit. But just as quickly, he’s just as content curling up beside you for some serious relaxation and quality cuddle time. Nitro is a true social butterfly in the pet world. He’s cat-friendly and dog-friendly, making him an ideal member of a multi-pet household. Whether he’s sharing space with feline friends or canine companions, Nitro is easy-going, respectful, and gets along famously with everyone. Plus, he’s fantastic with children of all ages; gentle, patient, and always ready to be part of the family fun. This affectionate boy absolutely thrives on attention and love. He’s the type of dog who will happily follow you around the house just to be near you, eagerly accepting all the pets, scratches, and belly rubs you can offer. Nitro’s love tank is bottomless, and he’s not shy about letting you know when he needs a little extra TLC. Nitro also appreciates his crate—a cozy, safe haven where he can retreat when he wants some downtime or a peaceful nap after a busy day of adventures and play. He’s well-behaved, adaptable, and loves having a comfy spot to call his own. If you’re searching for a loving, well-rounded companion who fits seamlessly into a bustling household, Nitro might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Bat Man
TEXT: Meet Bat Man! 🦇 Don’t let the name fool you—Bat Man is a laid-back greyhound with a heart as soft as his adorable fluffy coat. He’s happiest when surrounded by his fellow greyhounds, loving their company and enjoying the calm, easy-going life of a true greyhound gentleman. Bat Man hasn’t been tested with smaller dogs yet, but he’s got such a chilled-out nature that we’re hopeful he’d take things in stride with the right introduction. This easy going guy adores his human friends and is always up for some quality time; whether it’s a gentle pat, a slow stroll, or just hanging out together. He’s happy to cruise about at his own relaxed pace, taking in the world with a contented smile. Bat Man’s combination of chilled vibes, fluffy charm, and love for his greyhound pals makes him a wonderful companion for someone looking to add a calm, affectionate friend to their home.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Meet Dolly! 🐾 If you’re looking for a greyhound with more zoomies than a rocket ship and more confidence than a dog who just found the best stick in the park, Dolly is your girl! This strong, sleek speedster LOVES to run circles around her greyhound buddies, she’s basically the social butterfly of the greyhound world. Dolly is fantastic with other greyhounds and could probably teach a masterclass in making furry friends. Smaller dogs? Well, she hasn’t met many yet, so we’re keeping that adventure open for the future—think of it as a “coming soon” episode in the Dolly saga! This girl has impeccable recall, which means when you call her, she’s basically a furry missile zooming back to you (unless she’s mid-zoomie, then you might just be part of the fun chase). She’s strong too, so if you’re ready for some workout sessions disguised as dog walks, Dolly’s got you covered. She’d be happiest with a backyard where she can unleash those famous zoomies and show off her impressive speed and grace (or maybe just run in hilarious circles). Dolly’s confidence means she can fit comfortably into most homes, as long as you’re ready for some lively fun and lots of tail wags. In short: Dolly is the four-legged combination of a sprinter, socialite, and comedian—all wrapped up in a gorgeous greyhound package. Are you ready for zoomies, belly rubs, and endless fun? Because Dolly definitely is!

NAME: Popeye
TEXT: *Hi, I've just gone to foster care! Reach out to meet me!* Foster Update: "Popeye has been an absolute delight. Popeye is funny, loving & just such a sweet boy at heart. He has adapted well to being left outside while we are at work. We leave at 7:30 & are back around 5. I was unsure how he would go toilet training but he hasn’t had a single accident inside. I try to get him to go before bed & he doesn’t need to go out again until we’re all up in the morning. The stairs have not been an issue & he tackled them from day one like a pro. For our first foster, we couldn’t have wished for a better one. I think almost any household would suit him. A couple looking for a fur baby or even an older retired person / couple. He’s happy in the company of others, but also happy to be on his own. He doesn’t mind having cuddles with you, either on the floor in his bed or up on our bed. We all love him to bits & really hope we’re setting him up well to find his forever home. Anyone would be lucky to have him. " Looking for a fun-loving Greyhound with lots of personality? Meet Popeye, a charming boy who’s equal parts confident and affectionate! Popeye would suit full time workers as he has shown he is happy to settle alone. Popeye walks beautifully on lead and enjoys exploring the world with confidence, even tackling full staircases like a pro! Popeye may be able to go home with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet. He’d thrive best in a home without young children, perhaps a home with adults or older children could be where he finds his new home. A small courtyard or backyard would be ideal, as he loves to show his playful side with a zoom around the yard. Popeye is affectionate, playful, and has loads of love to share. If you're ready for a goofy, loyal companion who’ll keep you smiling, Popeye is your guy! Meet him at Western Sydney.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: *I have just aced my 8 weeks of foster care and I'm ready to go home with you!* Foster Update: "Matey is going great, enjoys his walks, enrichment toys and especially enjoys food! He now comes inside and runs straight to his bed and lies down, without me even needing to tell him, we are blown away with how well he is going!" Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and gentle, curious and affectionate nature, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey suits full time workers and loves spending his days outside with enrichment during the day - making him a great outdoor dog for a family looking for a pet who spends most of their time outside. Matey is an enthusiastic, gentle, smart and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a laid back yet playful friend. Matey suits full-time workers, and would enjoy a small yard to call his own. This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Elsa
TEXT: Meet Elsa! 🐾 Elsa is a bright, outgoing lady who absolutely adores children and makes friends wherever she goes! Full of energy and curiosity, Elsa is a true little adventurer who loves exploring new places and sniffing out exciting smells. She’s always up for a walk, a run, or a fun day out discovering the world around her. Elsa’s friendly and affectionate nature means she bonds quickly with everyone she meets—whether that’s kids, other dogs, or new people. She’s great with other dogs, enjoying playtime and company, but she also knows when it’s time to relax and soak up some cuddles. Her love of treats makes training and learning new tricks a breeze, and she’s always ready to show off a happy wag or two! If you’re looking for a loving, lively companion who will bring energy, affection, and lots of joy to your family, Elsa is your girl. She’s ready to leap into your life with boundless enthusiasm and fill your days with fun adventures and warm snuggles. Could Elsa be the energetic and loving friend you’ve been waiting for?

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Cindy is a sweet, quiet girl, who is lovely and soft with other dogs. She warms up well once you get to know her and becomes very sweet and affectionate. Cindy would suit a nurturing home where they can take things slow, but we're sure she will come out of her shell! A quiet home with a backyard to retreat to would be a perfect match for Cindy as she settles into pet life. A home without little kids is best suited as she is on the shy side. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jeda
TEXT: Jeda is a sweet girl who warms up nicely and has little excitable moments including chasing toys around. This gorgeous girl is excitable/confident and walks beautifully on the lead. She is a sweet girl who would suit a home with another greyhound buddy and a backyard to call her own. Jeda is as gorgeous inside as she is out - we can't wait for you to meet her! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tails
TEXT: Meet Tails 🐕‍🦺 Tails is a sweet and sensitive girl who would truly flourish with a little extra support and patience. While she can be timid and shy when meeting new people, once she feels safe and comfortable, she blossoms into a loving and loyal companion. Tails would hugely benefit from foster care or a home with another well-adjusted dog to help show her the ropes of pet life. Having a confident canine friend by her side will give her the guidance and reassurance she needs to gain confidence in her new surroundings. She gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company, but she thrives best in a calm, low-key lifestyle where she can take things at her own pace without feeling overwhelmed. If you have a gentle home and a furry friend willing to help Tails settle in, you could be the perfect match to help this beautiful girl come out of her shell and experience all the love and joy she deserves.

NAME: Tim Tam
TEXT: Whether you're a double coat, caramel or an original Tim Tam fan, we can all agree Tim Tams are a sweet treat and a family favourite. He is the perfect blend of calm natured and sometimes playful, what more could you want in a canine companion. He walks lovely on the lead and would suit a home without exposure to small dogs. Tim Tam gets along with dogs his size. Due to his friendly nature, he will suit a family that have respectful children. Tim Tam comes when called and is polite around new people! Tim Tam is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Wooly
TEXT: Hey, I'm Wooly! I'm a quiet guy, looking for a quiet home. I warm up to new people but would prefer a nurturing chilled out place to call my own. I'd love my own backyard and don't mind mingling with other dogs big or small. I love food and will enjoy learning new tricks in my forever home. A home without children is best for me. I can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Brax
TEXT: Meet Brax 🐾! Brax is a delightful boy with a playful and affectionate personality that instantly wins hearts. He’s had wonderful experience being around small children, showing a calm and gentle demeanour that makes him a fantastic addition to family life. Brax has also seen chickens and cats during his time, though he hasn’t been formally tested with them, so a slow, supervised introduction would help everyone feel comfortable. This handsome boy loves the company of other medium to large dogs and enjoys socializing and playing with his furry pals. Whether it’s a lively play session or just hanging out side by side, Brax thrives in a dog-friendly environment where he can be active and engaged. While he’s full of playful energy, Brax also knows how to relax and truly enjoys lying in his crate, which he finds cozy and safe and a perfect spot to recharge after a busy day. One of his most lovable traits is how much he loves to show affection. He’s not shy about letting you know when he wants some love, and he delights in offering cuddles and warm moments to those he trusts. Brax is looking for a forever home where he can be part of a loving family who appreciates his playful spirit and gentle heart. If you’re seeking a sweet, social, and affectionate greyhound who’s great with kids and loves spending time with other dogs, Brax might be the perfect fit for you!

NAME: Turtle
TEXT: Meet Turtle 🐢! Turtle is a truly beautiful greyhound with a sleek, shiny coat and a striking presence that turns heads wherever he goes.
