But don’t let his elegant looks fool you—this boy is full of energy, strength, and playful spirit! He’s a strong, athletic dog who loves to engage in fun, active play sessions, so he would thrive best in a home with other big dogs who can match his pace and with older kids who understand how to interact with a lively, robust canine companion. Turtle would prefer to live in a house where he has plenty of space to move around, explore, and feel comfortable. While he enjoys his energetic playtime, he also has a big heart and absolutely adores affection and attention from his humans. Whether it’s a good belly rub, a cozy cuddle, or just being near the people he loves, Turtle is happiest when showered with love. Another great thing about Turtle is that he’s crate trained, which means he’s not only fun and affectionate but also well-behaved and easy to manage in a family setting. He’s looking for a forever home where he can be part of an active family who understands his playful nature and can provide the exercise, companionship, and care he deserves. If you’re looking for a loyal, strong, and loving companion who will fill your home with joy and energy, Turtle is the perfect boy for you!

NAME: Jill (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Jill is a confident, friendly and affectionate girl described as 'wonderful' by her trainers here at the adoption centre. If you're looking for a super smart and focused girl, Jill's known cues are: name/recall, 'on your bed', off, down, touch, shake, chin rest, and drop (a toy). Jill loves toys & will play fetch with you. Her ideal home is a house with a backyard with colorbond fencing with shorter hours alone while she settles in. Jill requires a home without exposure to other dogs and requires an owner who lives in a low small dog populated area. She would thrive with an experienced greyhound owner who can continue her human engagement, training, focus training, and things like stationing on a bed, performing cues and recalling. She is happy to entertain herself in the yard during the day making her a good fit for those who work full-time and want a loving companion welcome them home everyday. Meet Jill at Western Sydney!

NAME: Spring
TEXT: Meet Spring! 🌼 Spring is a sweet-natured girl with a heart as soft as her gorgeous greyhound coat. She’s one of those dogs who makes life easier just by being around – relaxed, gentle, and incredibly easy to handle. Whether you’re an experienced dog owner or new to life with pups, Spring fits in effortlessly. She’s a real social butterfly, getting along brilliantly with all other dogs and loving the company of people. If you’ve got visitors, expect Spring to be first in line for a gentle hello and a little tail wag. She's a friendly soul who just wants to be included in the love. Spring would be a great fit for a family home, including one with respectful children. Her calm and steady personality makes her a safe and lovely companion for little ones. While she’s a joy in almost every way, Spring is still working on perfecting her lead manners – nothing too tricky, just a bit of ongoing training and consistency, and she’ll have it down in no time. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance, and loving dog who enjoys companionship and will bring a peaceful energy to your home, Spring could be your perfect match.

NAME: Ginger
TEXT: Meet Ginger – the gorgeous brindle lounge lizard! Ginger is a happy, friendly girl who loves being with her people and enjoys a pat or three. After a quick morning zoom around the yard, she’s ready to curl up on the couch or your bed for a well-earned nap. She enjoys daily walks with her 14-year-old walking buddy and is calm, gentle, and easy to walk with. Ginger would thrive in a home where she can spend time inside with you — and if you head out, she’s happiest staying indoors, being a well house-trained girl. She lives harmoniously with her small dog friends, a Pug and a Mini Foxy. She is also good with a house cat, sleeping happily with it. Ginger is a bit picky with food - luckily dog biscuits are her favourite, occasionally topped with sardines or a bit of chicken. Very easy! Ginger is a sweet-natured, easygoing companion who’ll fill your home with love, fun and laughs when she has her moments of excitement, as well as plenty of lazy-day charm. An all rounder girl, certainly one of a kind. 💘

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Isn't Paul the cutest little guy? Meet Paul, a super calm and polite boy. Paul is charming and laid back, your quintessential cool calm and collected greyhound. He is sweet, positive and engaging. He has mingled well with big and small dogs, thanks to his tolerant and generous nature, we think he would suit a home with another dog/s. TEXT: Belle is a happy, vibrant and energetic girl who is affectionate and social! She loves all the fun things in pet life - treats, zoomies, attention and play! NAME: Dina
TEXT: Hi, I'm Dina, I'm a shy but sweet girl looking for someone to nurture and calm my nerves. I am sweet and polite and I promise to be your new best friend, I'm just a little unsure when I first meet you. NAME: Rev
TEXT: Meet Rev ⚡! Rev is a handsome and energetic boy who loves nothing more than making new friends—both human and canine alike. With excellent recall, he’s eager to listen and respond, but he does have a strong lead presence that means he’d benefit from a bit more training to help him channel all that enthusiasm in the best way possible. Rev is incredibly social and friendly, and he’ll always be the first to say hi with a wagging tail and a big smile. His love for other greyhounds is clear—he thrives when he’s around his own kind, enjoying playful interactions and company that keeps his spirits high. An explorer at heart, Rev is happiest when he’s out and about, taking in new sights and scents with boundless curiosity and energy. He’s ready for an active home that can keep up with his zest for life and support his ongoing training to help him become the best version of himself. If you’re looking for a friendly, lively, and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to share adventures and endless greetings, Rev is your guy!

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Meet Gem 💎! This gorgeous girl has a heart full of love and a gentle, shy nature that takes a little time to come out of her shell. At first, Gem might feel a bit reserved as she gets used to new surroundings and people, but with patience and a calm environment, she quickly settles in and reveals her true, loving self. Gem would thrive best in a household where someone is usually around—whether working from home, part-time, or just a steady presence—so she never feels alone and can build her confidence at her own pace. One of Gem’s greatest joys is spending time with her doggy friends. She loves to play and interact with other dogs, showing her friendly and sociable side once she feels comfortable. Gem also adores children and enjoys their playful energy, making her a wonderful companion for families with kids who can engage her in gentle games and fun activities. Though she may start off a little shy, once Gem has warmed up to you, she’s a total cuddle queen. She loves curling up close, soaking in affection, and sharing those quiet, cozy moments that truly bond a dog and their human. Her sweet, gentle spirit shines through in these calm times, reminding you just how special she is. If you’re looking for a patient, loving, and devoted friend who will blossom beautifully in a supportive and caring home, Gem is waiting to meet you. With time, love, and consistency, this gentle girl will become a treasured member of your family, bringing warmth and happiness every day.

NAME: Snooty
TEXT: Snooty is a charming boy with a heart full of love and a tail that’s always wagging. NAME: Tammy
TEXT: Tammy is a smart, curious girl who does excellent with training. Meet this gorgeous girl by applying! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Lonnie
TEXT: Hey, I'm Lonnie! With my big happy smile, I hope I catch your eye! I'm a friendly girl to people and dogs alike, making me a wonderful family pet. NAME: Angel
TEXT: Hi, I'm angel, a gentle mannered quiet girl looking for a forever home. I'm middle aged, making me sweet and calm and ready to snooze by your side. Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Sooky 🐾 Sooky is a beautiful girl with a soft heart and a gentle spirit. She’s the kind of girl who doesn’t ask for much — just a calm home, a comfy spot inside, and someone who understands her sensitive nature. Sooky can be a little unsure when left alone for long periods, so she'd do best in a home where she has access to the indoors during the day, especially if her humans are out. Having that safe, familiar space helps ease her anxiety and lets her settle in comfortably. She currently lives on a property with a cattle dog and gets along well, so she could definitely benefit from having another calm, furry companion to keep her company. Sooky is small dog workable, and with a slow and respectful introduction, she may also be cat workable — she’s happy to coexist and just vibe out with her friends. This lovely girl has no need for chaos — she’s all about the peaceful life. She enjoys a quiet day, a gentle stroll, and the comfort of knowing she’s not alone. Whether she’s lying in a sunny patch of grass or relaxing on the couch, Sooky brings a quiet calm wherever she goes. If you're looking for a sweet, sensitive greyhound who just wants a peaceful home, a bit of company, and a place to feel safe, Sooky might just be the perfect fit.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris 🐾 Looking for a big-hearted best mate with extra-long legs and even longer cuddle sessions? Say hello to Boris — a supersized sweetheart who’s equal parts lounge lizard and lovebug! The only way to describe him is…. A gentle giant. Boris is a big boy (and he knows it!), but don’t let his size fool you — he’s a total softie who lives for snuggles and affection. If there’s a comfy spot and a human nearby, Boris is already there, leaning in for pats and making himself right at home. He loves hanging out with his fellow greyhounds and is a bit of a social butterfly in the dog world. Whether it's chilling in the backyard or going for a casual group walk, Boris is all about the good vibes and friendly company. Car rides? Trailer trips? No worries! Boris is calm, cool, and collected on the move. He travels like a seasoned pro — just give him a spot to settle and he’s happy to watch the world go by (or take a nap en route to his next adventure). Boris would love a home where he can lounge around, share his oversized heart, and maybe steal a spot on the couch (or at least a corner!). If you’re after a chill, cuddly, and all-around lovely lad to complete your family — Boris is ready to roll right into your life and never look back.

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Meet Danny 🐕 Danny is a charming and affectionate boy with a big heart and a friendly soul. He absolutely adores other greyhounds and thrives in their company. Although he hasn’t been tested around smaller dogs yet, his gentle and calm nature suggests he could adapt well with the right introduction. Danny has lived happily with young children and has proven to be a patient and loving friend to the little ones in his life. He’s used to the hustle and bustle of a busy home and enjoys being part of a family environment where he can share lots of love and attention. One of Danny’s standout qualities is how beautifully he walks on the lead — calm, polite, and well-mannered, he makes every walk a pleasant experience. He’s also very trainable and responds well to crate training, which helps him settle and feel secure when needed. Danny would do best in a home that has a backyard or safe outdoor space where he can stretch his legs, enjoy some fresh air, and have the freedom to relax and play. He’s not just an energetic pup; he’s a true people-lover who thrives on companionship and bonds closely with his humans. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly, and devoted greyhound who will fit seamlessly into a loving home, Danny could be your perfect match. He’s ready to share his heart and make new memories with a family that can give him the care and affection he deserves.

NAME: Lawsie
TEXT: Meet Lawsie 🐾 Lawsie is a vibrant and confident boy who’s bursting with energy and enthusiasm for life! This lively boy loves nothing more than spending time with his fellow greyhounds — their company really makes him shine. With a slow and careful introduction, Lawsie can also learn to get along well with small dogs, though he’s better suited to a household that understands his playful and excitable nature. Lawsie thrives in a home with older children who can keep up with his high energy and enjoy joining in on his fun adventures. He’s happiest when he’s zooming around, chasing his favorite toys, and letting loose with the classic greyhound zoomies that will bring a smile to anyone’s face. His playful spirit and bright personality make him a true bundle of joy to be around. While Lawsie is friendly and outgoing, he is a bit stronger on the lead due to his excitement, so some patient lead training will help him focus and walk calmly by your side. This little guy is eager to learn and wants to impress his new family! If you’re looking for a confident, happy-go-lucky companion who will fill your home with energy and love, Lawsie could be the perfect match. He’s ready to bring endless fun and affection to a patient family who can match his pace and appreciate his wonderful personality.

NAME: Speedy
TEXT: Meet Speedy 🐕‍🦺 Speedy is a true friend to all dogs and thrives on socializing with his canine companions. He’s incredibly friendly and easy going, but when it comes to smaller pups, he appreciates those who are confident and respectful—he knows how to set boundaries without fuss. With the right doggy friends, Speedy blossoms into the perfect playmate and loyal buddy, making him an ideal addition to a multi-dog household where everyone gets along peacefully. Travel is no trouble for Speedy; in fact, he’s always eager to hop in the van and go on new adventures. Whether it’s a quick trip to the park, a visit to the vet, or a day out exploring, Speedy handles car rides like a seasoned pro. His calm demeanour makes traveling stress-free and enjoyable for everyone involved. On walks, Speedy is a dream. He walks beautifully on the lead, matching your pace with effortless grace and a happy tail wag. His cruisy personality shines through every step, making your daily strolls a pleasure rather than a chore. Beyond his sociable nature with dogs and his love for travel, Speedy has a wonderfully happy and relaxed attitude towards life. He’s content to chill at home, soak up some sun, or simply be near his humans, always with a calm, gentle presence that brings peace to any household. If you’re looking for a well-mannered, sociable, and super laid-back companion who loves life, good company, and peaceful adventures, Speedy is the one to meet. With his loving nature and easy going spirit, he’s ready to cruise his way into your heart and home.

NAME: Johnno
TEXT: Meet Johnno 🐾 If you’re after a four-legged friend who’s basically the life of the dog park, meet Johnno! This easy going greyhound is the friendliest fellow around, with a heart big enough to love every dog he meets—no matter their breed, size, or background. From tiny terriers to giant retrievers, Johnno’s your go-to guy for making furry friends everywhere he goes. Johnno is polite, well-mannered, and knows how to keep things chill. He’s got a laid-back vibe that’s infectious, and new people? New places? No problem at all! He strolls into new situations with a wagging tail and a big, confident smile, showing zero stress and 100% charm. Whether it’s a bustling park or a quiet street, Johnno takes it all in stride like the cool, confident companion he is. Travel? Bring it on! Johnno is a seasoned pro in the car—no fuss, no drama—just happy to hop in and enjoy the ride. Road trips, vet visits, or weekend getaways, he’s your easy-to-travel-with buddy who’s always ready for the next adventure. With Johnno, you get a loving, social butterfly who thrives on meeting new friends, both two-legged and four-legged. He’s the kind of dog who will greet everyone politely but happily, making friends everywhere he goes without a hint of stress or worry. If you want a calm, friendly, and adaptable companion with a big heart and an even bigger smile, Johnno is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Meet Millie 🌿 Millie is a lovely greyhound with a gentle spirit who tends to be a little nervous in new situations. She needs some encouragement and lots of patience as she learns to feel safe and comfortable in her new surroundings. With the right support, Millie will blossom into a loving and devoted companion. Because Millie is shy, she would benefit hugely from foster care, where she can receive one-on-one attention and gentle guidance during her initial settling-in phase. A quiet, calm household would be the perfect environment for her to grow in confidence without feeling overwhelmed. Millie is good with cats and would happily share her home with them. When it comes to other dogs, she’ll need a slow and careful introduction to build trust and feel at ease. With time and gentle encouragement, she can learn to enjoy canine company. This special girl is looking for someone with a kind heart who understands that patience and love are the keys to helping her settle in and feel truly at home. If you have a calm space and the time to nurture Millie’s confidence, she could be the perfect addition to your life.

NAME: Dancer
TEXT: Meet Dancer 💃 Dancer is a beautiful girl with a quiet charm and a soul full of tenderness. A little shy at first, she takes her time to get comfortable in new surroundings—but once she gets to know you, she reveals the sweetest, most affectionate side of herself. She loves companionship but prefers to make the first move. Once she feels safe, she’ll come to you for affection. Dancer is looking for a calm, peaceful home where she can truly relax and come into her own. A quieter household, free from too much hustle and bustle, would suit her best—somewhere she can settle at her own pace and feel secure. She’d do well with older, respectful children who can give her the gentle space she needs to flourish. She’s wonderfully polite with other animals and gets along well with both dogs and cats. Whether she joins a home with other calm pets or becomes your one and only, she’ll be a loyal and loving presence once she finds her confidence. This lovely girl isn’t looking for loud excitement or constant attention—just a safe place, kind people, and the chance to build a bond that runs deep. With a little time, a lot of love, and plenty of patience, Dancer will reward you with quiet loyalty and a heart full of trust. Dancer is ready to find her soft place to land.

NAME: Elsa
TEXT: Look at my adorable puppy dog eyes...now click here to learn more about me! I am a happy, bright girl who is on the more active and confident side. I am social with other greyhounds and enjoy attention, pats and all the fuss you have to give me. My favourite treat is Mcdonalds ice cream, and I'm super gentle around children, too! I'd love a backyard to romp around in with the family kids and lots of fun toys to keep me occupied! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Suzie
TEXT: If you're looking for a beautiful blue girl, who is soft natured, middle aged and laid back - click here! Suzie would be a great addition to a home with another greyhound as she has lived along side one. She is gentle, social, confident and laid back. She would do best with a small outdoor area to call her own (courtyard/townhouse) and would enjoy laid back daily walkies. She promises to walk perfectly on lead for you. Suzie is a sweet girl who can't wait to meet you at the Western Sydney Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a happy, social guy who’s always ready to make new friends and find a place to call home! He’s full of charm, loves his treats and meeting new humans while hes out and about. Ace has shown to walk beautifully on lead and would be a great addition to a home with a medium to large dog who enjoys some company, pending a meet and greet. His friendly nature and love of being part of the action make him a joy to have around. If you're after a loyal mate with a sweet personality and a love for life, Ace might just be your perfect match! Meet Ace at Western Sydney.

TEXT: *Richard is in foster care!* Richard foster update: - Full time hour suited - Richard has settled well into Newtown, he seems relaxed and settles at the park - Loves the van and has gone camping - Has been learning staircases - Loves the beach and the sand - Has played with 2 year old children, likes when they are on the calmer side - Can settle when alone and is toilet trained Richard is a charming greyhound, full of curiosity and a calm, friendly nature. He’s great on the lead and loves meeting new people, making him a wonderful companion for walks and outings. Having grown up with his greyhound pals, Richard would be happy in a home with another dog, who can match his easy-going spirit, he has also tested positively with cats and could be rehomed with small animals. Come meet Richard at Western Sydney.

NAME: Georgia
TEXT: This sweet girl has entered her golden years and is ready to find her forever home! Georgia warms up to new people in no time and loves affection, often leaning in for more pats and scratches behind the ear (an easy way to win her over!). Georgia would prefer a quieter home with a laid back life style so she can spend her days upside down on a couch or catching rays in the yard. A home with adults or older children would also best suit Georgia. She gets a long well with other Greyhounds so pending a meet and greet, could suit a home with another medium to large canine friend. Meet Georgia at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jerry
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jerry! I love kids aged 2 up and have lots of experience with them, I'm gentle and love the attention if I'm honest! I'm super easy on lead, not an active dog but loves attention when seeing visitors, and would love to get out and have a play with you in the yard during the day! I like travelling in cars and vans, easy to walk on the lead and love playing with squeaky toys. I could live with other dogs male or female, and I'm ready to show off my happy go lucky energy! Adopt me from the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a sweet and gentle soul who’s looking for a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace. With slow and careful introductions, she could potentially be okay around smaller dogs, especially those who are calm and respectful. NAME: Bob
TEXT: Meet Bob 🐾 Introducing Bob, a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, easy-going nature. Bob is the kind of companion who doesn’t need much – just a quiet home, some treats, and a loving human (or two) to call his own. Bob is friendly with other dogs, cat-tolerant, and would do well in a home with older, respectful children. His gentle demeanour and soft, soulful eyes make him a peaceful presence, and he’s happiest when surrounded by the people he loves. This sweet boy has so much affection to give and loves nothing more than being close to his human family. He’s more than happy to chill out for most of the day, watching the world go by from a comfy spot in the house, or curling up next to you for some quiet company. Bob isn’t looking for adventure – just a calm, loving home where he can feel safe, relaxed, and cherished. If you’re after a loyal companion who will bring peace, love, and gentle tail wags into your life, Bob might just be the perfect match. NAME: Nicko
TEXT: Meet Nicko 💤 🐾 Looking for a calm, low-maintenance companion to match your relaxed lifestyle? Nicko might be your perfect match. This laid-back greyhound boy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. With his gentle nature and love for the quiet life, Nicko would thrive in a peaceful home with someone who enjoys a slower pace and values the joy of simple companionship. Nicko is incredibly relaxed around other dogs and enjoys the company of canine friends. He’s also shown a calm curiosity around children, making him a lovely addition to a home with respectful kids who understand his mellow vibe. And here's a bonus – Nicko could live with a cat! With a careful and slow introduction, he may adapt well to a feline housemate, making him a rare gem in the greyhound world. Nicko isn't the type to demand constant attention or high-energy adventures – a comfy bed, a few gentle walks, and the quiet presence of his human(s) is all he needs to be content. He’s ideal for someone who works from home, is retired, or simply prefers the comfort of a more peaceful routine. If you’re ready to share your life with a sweet, chilled-out greyhound who just wants to be near you and enjoy the calm moments, Nicko is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: Meet Emma 🐾 Say hello to Emma, a gentle, affectionate, and quietly charming greyhound with a heart full of love. With her graceful presence and calm nature, Emma is the kind of dog who quickly becomes the heart of any home. She loves nothing more than spending time with her people – whether that’s relaxing on the couch, following you around the house, or just being nearby while you work or unwind. Emma walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys her daily strolls, especially when she gets to catch up with her greyhound friends. She’s well-mannered around other medium to large dogs and has a calm, friendly way about her that makes her easy to get along with. Emma is also great with children and would be a wonderful companion for a family or a household with visiting grandkids. While she’s happy to snooze the day away in true greyhound fashion, Emma does best when she has company. She would thrive in a home where someone is around most of the time – whether you work part-time or from home, Emma will be your loyal and loving sidekick. If you’re looking for a gentle soul with lots of love to give, Emma is ready to steal your heart and become your new best friend.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾🌟 Charlie is a gentle, slightly reserved greyhound who quickly warms up once he feels settled and safe. This calm and affectionate boy enjoys exploring the world through his nose, taking in all the smells and sights on his sniffing adventures. Charlie thrives on companionship and would be happiest in a home where he can be part of the family’s daily life. He’s great with other dogs and cats, making him an ideal addition to a multi-pet household. Charlie’s easy-going nature means he adapts well to new environments, especially with a little patience and time to adjust. Charlie would do best in a home where he isn’t left alone for long periods. He loves having company, whether that’s a family with kids to keep him entertained or someone who works from home or part-time, so he never feels lonely. If you’re looking for a sweet, adaptable companion who loves to explore and enjoys the company of both humans and other pets, Charlie is ready to be your loyal friend. Charlie would be most suited to: A multi-pet household with dogs and/or cats A family environment with children who can provide gentle companionship A home where someone is present part-time or works from home An owner or family willing to give him time and patience to settle in A calm and loving environment where he can enjoy daily sniffing adventures and relaxed walks If Charlie sounds like your perfect match, do not hesitate to come and meet him!

NAME: Scarlette
TEXT: Meet Scarlett!🐾❤️ Scarlett is a joyful girl with a bright and confident personality that lights up any room she enters. She’s a social sweetheart who gets along wonderfully with all dogs and even likes cats, making her a fantastic fit for a multi-pet household. This happy girl would thrive in a loving family environment where she can enjoy plenty of company and affection. Scarlett’s confident nature means she’s comfortable exploring new places and meeting new friends, whether they have two legs or four. While Scarlett is a great walker overall, she could benefit from a bit of training on the lead to help her become an even better walking companion. With some patience and positive reinforcement, she’ll master those walks in no time! If you’re looking for a cheerful, adaptable greyhound who’ll bring joy and companionship to your family, Scarlett might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Archie
TEXT: Meet Archie 🐾 ✨ Archie is a truly wonderful boy with a heart full of social spirit and a calm, confident nature. He absolutely adores spending time with other greyhounds and is happiest when he has a canine buddy by his side. Archie is great with medium to large dogs and fits perfectly into a multi-dog home where he can enjoy plenty of furry company. But it’s not just other dogs that Archie loves — he’s incredibly social and affectionate with people too! Archie thrives on human interaction and is always eager to make new friends, whether it’s a quick pat or some relaxed downtime together. His easy-going temperament means he’s not phased by much — busy environments, new places, or changes in routine don’t rattle this laid-back boy. Archie would do well in a home with older children who understand how to respect boundaries and enjoy gentle play. His calm and steady demeanour makes him a wonderful companion for families, singles, or anyone looking for a loyal, loving dog who’s ready to be part of the family. If you want a confident, friendly, and adaptable greyhound who gets along with both dogs and humans alike, Archie is the perfect match!

NAME: Jason
TEXT: Meet Jason, a sweet guy with lots of personality, ready to find a place to call home! A home with a backyard or courtyard would best suit Jason, so he can do his zoomies or have a snooze in the sun. NAME: Jitter
TEXT: Meet Jitter 🌸 Say hello to Jitter, a beautiful senior lady with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul. She’s in her golden years and is now searching for the perfect place to enjoy the peaceful, loving retirement she so deeply deserves. Jitter is the definition of easy-going. She’s friendly, affectionate, and content to go with the flow. She’s fantastic with other dogs – big and small – and is also completely cat-friendly, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes. She’s also happy to share her space with children, as long as they’re the calm, gentle type who understand her love for quiet companionship. While Jitter enjoys affection – especially a soft pat and a warm cuddle – she’s also totally fine doing her own thing. She’s independent in the best way, happy to potter around the house or snooze in a comfy spot nearby while you go about your day. She doesn’t demand attention, but she’ll always be ready for a cuddle when you are. Jitter would thrive in a calm, relaxed household where she can enjoy the simple pleasures: soft beds, gentle hands, a quiet garden or sunny windowsill, and the company of people and pets who appreciate her peaceful energy. She’s not the type to bounce around or seek adventure – instead, she’s looking for a home filled with comfort, love, and understanding. Jitter is a low-maintenance, high-love kind of girl who will bring calm, comfort, and quiet joy to the right home. Let her spend her golden years knowing she’s truly loved.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is the sweetest boy a heart full of love and legs built for adventure. This playful boy is looking for his forever home where he can shine as either your one-and-only or alongside another medium to large dog who matches his energy and style. 🐾 Personality & Temperament: Playful & affectionate – Jimmy loves to play and thrives on human interaction. Walk enthusiast – Walks are his favorite part of the day, and he’ll happily trot beside you rain or shine. Kid-friendly – Best suited to homes with older children who understand gentle dog manners. 🏡 Ideal Home: Jimmy would do best in a home where he’s either the only pet or paired with another dog of similar size. He’s not suited to living with small dogs or cats, but he’s got plenty of love to give to his human family.

NAME: Mindy
TEXT: Mindy is a little shy at first, but with a chance to warm up, she'll be showing you her goofy side in no time! Full time or part time workers may work for Mindy, she will just need a chance to build up to longer hours alone. Mindy would best suit a quiet home, with adults or older children to ease her into pet life. Although Mindy has been appropriate during her interactions with other dogs of all sizes, she would prefer to be the only dog in her new home, so she can have all the love to herself. Mindy loves a treat and has proven to be a real smarty pants, learning "down", "touch" and "shake" on cue! She has shown to settle well when left alone and while indoors, but would prefer a home with a yard or courtyard to have a play or a snooze. Come down and meet Mindy at Western Sydney!

NAME: Zara
TEXT: Zara is a chilled and easy going girl Zara would like a quiet home where she can chill with her family and perhaps go on a short walk every few days Zara has been living in a home and is quiet and easy to live with Zara has been socialised with small dogs and would be fine with a relaxed quiet small friend

NAME: Tago
TEXT: Tago is calm and gentle Tago has met and socialised with multiple breeds of dogs and is happy to interact but likes to just do his own thing Tago is a clean and quiet boy Tago has met a cat, but was too busy looking at his own reflection in the mirror to be bothered by her

NAME: Bingo
TEXT: *Bingo has spent some time in a home and has excelled with toilet training & learning pet routines* Meet Bingo, a confident, lovable guy, looking for a place to call home. He is super confident and loves to learn (he'll do anything for a treat). Bingo has been great with interactions with his greyhound mates so could suit a home with another medium to large breed companion, pending a meet and greet. A home without children is ideal. Bingo is toilet trained and can hold overnight if he sleeps indoors. Bingo has shown to do well indoors so a house or townhouse setting could be where he finds his new home, he may just need some time to settle into his new life and routine - access indoors and outdoors and a place to call his own is the best fit. A secluded resting zone would suit him the best. He has also demonstrated confidence on our training staircase but would need some supporting guidance from his new family to tackle more challenging flights. This should be a breeze given his love for treats and praise. Shout BINGO if you think he's the one!

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a vibrant and playful greyhound who’s full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He would thrive in an active home with a yard to run around in and older kids to keep him company. Bob is high on life, he loves his zoomies, enjoys playing with toys (his absolute favourite activity), and is always up for a cuddle once he’s had his fun. He walks well on lead and is very social, enjoying the company of people and other dogs. While he’s not a fan of cats, he might do well with a medium to small dog in the home, provided introductions are done slowly and with care. Bob travels beautifully in the car and takes everything in stride. He will need an experienced owner or someone patient and understanding, as he may take a little time to learn house manners and settle into a routine. He’s smart, enthusiastic, and eager to please, he just needs the right guidance. Overall, Bob is just happy to be here. With the right family, he’s going to be an incredibly fun and loving companion.

NAME: Larry
TEXT: Larry is a charming lovable boy. He is great with young kids and is social and confident. He could be good with fulltime workers as he relaxes well when left alone. He is a well balanced beautiful boy ready for his forever home.

NAME: Gary
TEXT: Hey mate, the names Gary, good to meet ya! I am a lovely, happy boy, and pretty much a friend to everyone I've met. Everyone loves Gary, if I do say so myself! I'll wag my tail like crazy, probably do a zoomie, but I don't mind my down time too mate! I reckon I could get along with your dog if you've already got one at home, and even those little trouble makers at home, I figure kids would be great fun, more attention for ol' Gary! Give me a backyard or a townhouse and I'll make myself right at home. I might not have been a pet before but I have such a can do attitude, I'll fit in anywhere. Come meet Gaz at Western Sydney.

NAME: José
TEXT: Hi! I have just met you and I love you! I'm José, a friendly, confident boy, I love people, pats and attention! I hope you can see how full of love I am from my cute photos. I will put my head on you and ask for more pats! I'm a sweet guy who is good around other dogs, including mingling with small dogs at times. I don't mind chilling out in a crate but I don't need one! I'd love a backyard, a social life, adventures, and maybe even children to give me lots of pats and adoration, too! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Pat
TEXT: Hi, I'm Pat! I promise to be the bestest boy ever! I hope you like me too. I am a very friendly and affectionate boy. I love food and can be a little shy. I am called a lounge lizard by my current family. I've even done things like go to the beach, meet children, and see the sights on street walks. I don't really show much interest in toys but I have perfected the greyhound zoomie. A paddock gallop is my 'happy place'. I hope you have a backyard for me to chill out in! You can meet me and "Pat me" at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Xena
TEXT: Xena is a cheeky, gentle and fun little girl. She likes food, and engages nicely with new people once she warms up from being intially a bit shy. Xena lives with another greyhound at the moment so we think she'd do well in a multi-dog household. Older kids would enjoy her gentle yet curious and playful side. Xena has also done things like street walks, hanging out with children, and other socialisation, making her a great companion for families. Her family say nothing phases her! Xena is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal 👑🐾 Royal is a delightful girl who truly lives up to her name. She’s a playful and affectionate sweetheart who adores making friends—especially with other dogs, no matter their size! Royal’s favourite thing in the world is playing with her furry pals, and she’ll happily invite any dog she meets to join in on the fun. Whether it’s a game of chase, tug, or just a joyful romp, Royal is always ready to play. This gentle lady would make a wonderful family pet. She’s calm and confident, not easily stressed by new people or environments, which makes her adaptable and easygoing in all kinds of settings. Royal loves her toys and can spend hours happily entertaining herself or sharing playtime with her favourite humans. When she’s not busy playing or making new friends, Royal is a cuddle bug who loves to snuggle up and soak in all the love and attention she can get. She’s a perfect balance of lively and laid-back—a true joy to have around. If you’re looking for a loving, playful, and incredibly social companion who will bring laughter and warmth into your home, Royal is ready to steal your heart and become your family’s new best friend.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Meet Tiger 🐾 Tiger is a confident and charismatic boy with a heart as big as his smile. This energetic bundle of joy is a true social butterfly who thrives on friendship—whether it’s with dogs big or small, Tiger’s easy-going nature and playful attitude make him a favourite in any multi-pet household. But don’t worry, he’s just as happy being the one and only furry family member, soaking up all the love and attention you can give. Tiger is the perfect blend of playful goofiness and calm confidence. He’s always ready to brighten your day with his silly antics, goofy grin, and endless tail wags. Despite his lively energy, he knows how to relax and enjoy quiet cuddle time, making him a well-rounded companion. What really sets Tiger apart is his gentle and loving spirit. He’s great with children, understanding and patient, making him an ideal family dog. Whether it’s playing games in the yard or snuggling up for story time, Tiger is sure to be a beloved member of your home. If you’re looking for a loyal, happy, and affectionate friend who will keep you smiling and fill your days with love, Tiger is the perfect match. He’s confident, outgoing, and ready to bring joy to a home that appreciates a lively, loving, and goofy boy with a heart full of love. Could Tiger be the one to steal your heart?

NAME: T Rex
TEXT: Meet T-Rex 🦕 Dog Friendly: Yes – best with medium to large dogs Child Friendly: Yes – best suited to a home with older children Ideal Home: A family with a secure backyard and an active lifestyle Don’t let the name fool you – T-Rex is all heart and happiness! This big, bouncy boy is bursting with personality and ready to find a family who’ll love his enthusiastic, affectionate nature. T-Rex is a social butterfly through and through. He’s currently living with other greyhounds and thrives in their company, especially those who can match his playful energy. He’s also friendly with medium and large dogs, and loves being part of a pack. This boy lives for his people – always close by, always ready to join in. Whether you're moving around the house or heading out for an adventure, expect T-Rex to be your loyal shadow. He’s interactive, affectionate, and happiest when included. T-Rex would do best in a home with older children who can enjoy his energy and help guide his big personality. A backyard is a must – he’s got some serious zoomie skills and needs space to stretch those long legs. While he’s eager to get out and explore, T-Rex can be strong on the lead, so he’ll need confident handlers who can continue his training and help him channel his excitement on walks. He will be your super social and loyal shadow and sidekick If you’re ready for a fun, affectionate, and outgoing greyhound who will bring non-stop joy and energy into your life, T-Rex is your guy.

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red ❤️ Say hello to Red – a tender-hearted boy with a sweet soul and the most soulful eyes you’ve ever seen. Red may be a little reserved at first, but once he feels safe and settled, he shows his loving personality in the most heartwarming ways. Red is great with other greyhounds and enjoys their calm, familiar company. He’s also been around smaller dogs – he just may need a slower, thoughtful introduction to build his comfort and confidence. With the right introductions and guidance, he’s more than happy to share his space with gentle doggy friends. Red has been around children in a home environment and handles it well with his naturally gentle nature. However, due to his shy disposition, a quieter home – perhaps with older, dog-savvy kids – would be the best match for him. He thrives in calm, predictable spaces where he can truly feel at ease. Red can be a bit nervous when meeting new people or exploring new situations, but give him time and patience, and you’ll be rewarded with the trust and love of a truly special dog. He prefers to interact on his own terms – not pushy or demanding, just quietly curious and kind. Red enjoys his peaceful moments, lounging nearby, quietly observing, and choosing when to come over for a little affection or company. His independence, mixed with his loving nature, makes him a calm and comforting presence in the home. Red would thrive in a gentle, patient home where he can settle in at his own pace and build trust with his new family. He doesn’t ask for much – just kindness, understanding, and a safe space where he can be himself. In return, you’ll get a loyal, loving companion with the sweetest heart.

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Vaughn has been described by his handlers as simply "amazing"! He is outgoing and affectionate with people & would suit a family home with a yard for him to relax in. He cannot wait to show you his Vaughn-derful personality! He is highly engaged with his training, best suited to house/townhouse living and settles alone well in a backyard setting. He’s already learned a bunch of tricks like 'down', shake, recall, his name, and on/off bed, and he’s currently working on sit. He’s quick to pick things up! He will need a home with a yard where he can run and play till his heart’s content. A family that will continue to help him on his training journey and a calm, loving environment where he can relax and feel secure. His best home is a family who want to do dog training, adventures and cool fun activities with him! Vaughn is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Zippa
TEXT: Meet Zippa!🐾 Zippa is a charming, affectionate boy who’s never met a dog he didn’t want to be friends with—especially if they’re fellow greyhounds! He thrives on canine company and is always the first to say hello with a happy wag and a gentle nuzzle. This social superstar settles quickly into new environments and brings calm confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a bustling park or a cozy home, Zippa makes himself right at home in no time. He absolutely adores human affection and will happily lean in for cuddles, neck scritches, and all the love you’re willing to give. With his friendly nature and easy-going personality, Zippa is a joy to have around and will make a wonderful companion for a home with other dogs—or just humans ready to shower him with love.

NAME: Pebbles
TEXT: Meet Pebbles! 🐶 Pebbles is a bright, bubbly, and super social greyhound who’s ready to win hearts wherever she goes! This lovely lady has a big personality and an even bigger heart — she adores the company of other dogs and gets along with absolutely everyone she meets, both two-legged and four. Pebbles has been well-socialised in the community and is comfortable and confident in a variety of environments. She’s spent plenty of time indoors and knows how to settle into home life with ease. Whether she's out and about or relaxing at home, Pebbles is always engaged, curious, and tuned into her humans. She’s a huge fan of pats, cuddles, and—of course—treats! Show her a snack and she’ll be your best friend in an instant. Her friendly, affectionate nature makes her a joy to be around, and she’s always up for a chat (or at least a tail wag and a nuzzle). Pebbles would thrive in a home where she can continue being part of the action—whether it’s social outings, doggy playdates, or simply lounging at your feet after a day full of love and attention. If you're looking for a sweet, sociable girl who’s already got the hang of home life and is ready to be your loyal companion, Pebbles is your perfect match.

NAME: Bobby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Bobby is a lovely, quiet and friendly boy who has experience with kids 6-10 yrs old. He's been learning about the family household and has spent time mingling with other breeds including German Shepherds, and would suit a home with a Medium-Large dog friend. He likes playing with kids, fine meeting new people and strangers, and has a confident, adaptable nature about him. Did we mention he has adorable floppy ears, too? Meet Bobby at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Son
TEXT: Hi, I'm Son! I've been described as calm, loving, sociable, and easy going! I'm happy travelling, snoozing in crates, snuggling into new people for a bit of attention and pats. I've got a charming nature and I think I'm pretty adaptable in new situations! I would suit respectful kids and a backyard to search for my toys in! I'm a confident fella who can't wait to meet you. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Edi
TEXT: Hi, I'm Edi! I was born on Christmas Day! I can be shy around new people but I promise to be a total love bug once I know you! I'm learning about all things "pet" right now including being indoors, things like couches and TV's are pretty cool! I also like the crate, and the splashy pool in summer! I'm learning about busy streets and have mingled with kids, too. I am quiet, affectionate, calm and friendly and hope you would like to come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Dennis
TEXT: Dennis is a polite and quiet natured, middle aged gentleman who is happy to receive pats and attention from any of his admirers. He is shy by nature and would suit a loving quiet home. Dennis would suit a home with respectful children. Dennis is learning to walk nicely on the lead and loves to catch up on all the sniffs around town while showing off his good looks. Dennis is a lovely gentleman who will thrive with a townhouse/backyard and or doggie friends to keep him company, or shorter hours alone at the start of his pet journey. He chooses to settle in a crate when indoors and likes when things are quiet and patient. Dennis would suit a likeminded calm family who are willing to take the time he needs. Dennis can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre

NAME: Diesel
TEXT: With his sweet little undershot jaw, Diesel oozes character both on the outside and on the inside! This sweet dog is good with children and other dogs, he is ready to slot right into family life and find a sofa to call his own. Whist he loves to play ball and goof around, Diesel is also happy to curl up next to his person for a cuddle and a snooze!

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris! 🐕 Boris is a high-energy, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. With his confident nature and bouncy enthusiasm, he’s always ready to play, explore, and soak up all the affection he can get. Boris gets along great with medium to large dogs and would thrive in an active home where he can be part of the action. Whether it’s going on adventures, playing in the yard, or just enjoying time with his people, Boris is all in. He would also love a friend at home to keep him company and is happy to play with him. If you’re an energetic family looking for a lively, loving companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Boris is your guy!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Gazza is a sweet boy who travels well in vans, cars and trailer, also walks well on lead on adventures out and about. Gazza has shown polite manners with children ranging from 20 months to 9 years old, showing a gentle & polite indifference. Gazza has spent time mingling with big and small dogs and would suit a home looking for a laid back boy happy to go with the flow. Gazza dreams of a little backyard to spend his days in and kids to keep him entertained during the day. He can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ocean
TEXT: Don't let my greying face fool you, I'm a friendly bubbly guy ready to join your family. Ocean is a curious and confident boy who loves his toys, has learnt his name and will even come when called. This serene boy walks nicely on the lead, too, making him a lovely walking companion. Ocean is a wonderful boy who is ready to bring balance and peace to his new home! Ocean can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack 🐾🌿 Jack is a confident, relaxed boy who takes everything in his stride. Whether it’s a new place, a new walk, or a new friend, Jack approaches life with a calm curiosity and a steady tail wag. He settles quickly into new environments, walks beautifully on the lead, and is a total pro when it comes to travelling. Whether you're heading out for a stroll or a weekend getaway, Jack is more than happy to come along for the ride. Jack’s gentle confidence and easy going nature make him a dream companion for anyone looking for a loyal friend who’s as chill as he is curious. If you're after a greyhound who’s ready to explore the world—but just as happy to lounge by your side—Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Meet Albert 🐾 Albert is a quiet, clean, and gentle soul who’s ready to find his forever home. He’s the kind of greyhound who takes life in his stride—literally! He walks beautifully on the lead, travels like a pro, and is an all-around easy companion. While he can be a little shy at first, Albert warms up quickly and really comes into his own once he’s settled. He absolutely loves a good run with his canine pals and gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Albert would thrive in a calm, loving home where he can enjoy his daily walks, zoomies with friends, and a comfy spot to relax. If you're looking for a sweet, well-mannered boy with a playful side, Albert might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: "I have recently gone into a foster home with another greyhound, stay tuned for updates." Thor – Mighty God of thunder and lightning and protector of mankind...this friendly boy from the moment he meets you, he’ll be buttering you up with his big puppy dog eyes asking for a treat. If you have an Avengers team of other hounds at home, we think that Thor wouldn’t mind some crime-fighting canine company, but he’s happy on his own as well for shorter stints of time alone to begin with. He would do best with a small grassed yard with opaque/colour bond fencing in a quiet neighbourhood as he can become overwhelmed with too much going on in the neighbourhood. His gentle and friendly nature would see him fit perfectly into a home with older kids or teens! If Thor (minus the hammer) sounds like the perfect fit for your Asgard, assemble your family, and together you can embark on a heroic journey to meet him at our Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Snippy
TEXT: Snippy is a relaxed, friendly, easy-going gentleman, who’s not jumpy and a dream on the lead. He’s super social, affectionate, and loves spending time with people - he just adores the grandkids aged 6 and up! Snippy’s happy nature makes him an excellent pet - he LOVES to lean on you and get cuddles, which we just love! He’s great with other calm natured greys, and would prefer shorter hours alone as a solo pet. He loves his daily walks, swimming adventures, and is very food-motivated making him a breeze to train. He’d thrive in a home with someone who has time to hang out with him and has a nice quiet backyard for him to chill out in. Snippy has mastered stairs so a home with some steps is A-O-K! This friendly fella is at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Meet Grace ☀️ Grace is a calm, friendly girl with a beautifully chilled personality and a love for the simple things in life — like a sunny spot to nap in and the company of other dogs. She’s previously lived happily with other canine companions and would love a home where she can continue to enjoy that friendship. She would be equally as happy being an only dog with her human friends. Grace has lived inside a home before; she walks nicely on the lead and travels well — making outings easy and enjoyable. Whether she's strolling beside you or stretching out in the sunshine, Grace brings a gentle, contented energy wherever she goes. She’s the perfect mix of affectionate and independent and would thrive in a home that appreciates her relaxed nature and loving heart. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who’s happy to share her space, her sunshine, and her heart — Grace is ready to meet you.

NAME: Edna
TEXT: Meet Edna 🌸 Edna is a lovely, soft-natured girl with a quiet charm and a heart full of potential. She enjoys the company of other dogs and her human friends. Edna walks beautifully on the lead and travels calmly, making her a joy to take out and about. While she may be a little shy at first, given time and gentle encouragement, she begins to show her sweet, affectionate personality. She would thrive in a quieter home where she can take things slowly and build confidence with patient people by her side, especially as she navigates new environments at her own pace. Once she feels settled, Edna blossoms — and her gentle companionship is truly special. If you're looking for a loyal friend to love and nurture, Edna might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Indi
TEXT: Meet Indi! 🐾 Indi is a sweet-natured girl with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging! She adores the company of other dogs and is always excited to make new canine (and human!) friends. With her calm and gentle nature, Indi is the kind of dog who turns heads and wins hearts wherever she goes. She's a fantastic traveller — relaxed and content whether it's a short trip to the park or a longer adventure. Patience is one of her superpowers, and she takes everything in stride with a happy grin and waggy tail. If you're looking for a friendly, sociable companion who's always happy to say hello, Indi is your girl. 💕🐶

NAME: Horse
TEXT: Meet Horse 🐾 Horse might have a big name, but he’s a total softie at heart. This gorgeous boy is the definition of laid-back – calm, collected, and always up for a cuddle or a tasty treat (he’s a bit of a snack connoisseur!). Horse gets along brilliantly with other dogs, making him the perfect companion whether you're out on a group walk or welcoming visitors at home. He travels like a pro, whether it's a quick ride or a longer trip, and he's even happy to wait patiently in the car while you pop into the shops – no fuss, no bother. Friendly with everyone he meets and just the right amount of nosey (we call it “curious charm”), Horse has a gentle soul and a curious streak that keeps life interesting. If you’re after a relaxed, loving dog who’s as easy-going as they come, Horse is your guy. Treat in hand? You’ve got a friend for life, the Gentle Giant with a heart of gold!

NAME: Kerry
TEXT: Kerry has grown up around very young kids and plays respectfully with them. Kerry is happy to play by day and relax by night making her a great companion and perfect for fulltime workers Kerry is good with other greyhounds and walks perfectly on lead With a proper introduction Kerry is cat workable and also small dog workable making her very versatile.

NAME: Sooky
TEXT: walks well on lead Confident and social. higher energy dog for someone thats looking for adventure and likes fitness jumps up and down playful and jumps up to give cuddles likes to go off and explore would love a big backyard good for fulltime working hours enjoys a zoomie

NAME: Franky
TEXT: Meet Franky 🐾 Franky is a sweet boy who adores the company of other dogs and would do well living with a feline friend, provided they have a very slow and gentle introduction. With his engaging personality, Franky loves to sniff and explore his surroundings, always curious about the world around him. He would thrive in a home with another pet to keep him company, especially where someone works from home or part-time, so he can enjoy plenty of companionship throughout the day. Franky’s playful spirit and affectionate nature make him a wonderful addition to a loving family ready to share adventures and quiet moments alike.

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Say Hello to Sam – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌱 Sam is a sweet boy who’s looking for a quiet home where he can truly come into his own. A little timid at first, Sam takes his time to get to know you– but once he feels settled, his playful and affectionate side begins to shine. He enjoys the simple joys in life: a gentle game in the yard with his canine friends, a few soft toys to toss around, and, of course, a tasty treat or two! Sam gets along well with other dogs and would love a calm canine companion to help boost his confidence. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, Sam will reward you with loyalty, quiet companionship, and those special moments that come from watching him blossom.

NAME: Davie
TEXT: Introducing Davie 🐾 Davie is a gentle, affectionate boy with a heart of gold and a tail that never stops wagging! This easy going boy is the perfect fit for just about any household – whether you have children, other dogs, or just need a calm companion by your side. He walks beautifully on a loose lead and has wonderfully relaxed body language, making strolls together an absolute pleasure. Davie is a social butterfly who gets along with dogs of all shapes and sizes, and his sweet, patient nature makes him a hit with kids too. Whether it’s lounging at home, greeting new friends, or enjoying a quiet walk, Davie’s laid-back personality and loving nature shine through in everything he does. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance friend with lots of love to give, Davie might just be your perfect match!

NAME: Bozo
TEXT: Bozo is a tall, shy, and gentle boy. He might be big and tall but he has a quiet, soft and wise personality. If you're looking for a very gentle giant, who loves to lean on you and look up at you with puppy dog eyes, Bozo is the perfect match. Bozo is such a gentleman, especially around other dogs. He is a calm, reserved boy who would suit a home who can build up his confidence. A quiet, understanding owner who is interested in helping shy dogs become the best confident version of themselves, would be the perfect fit for our gentle giant, Bozo. Come and meet him at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Stories
TEXT: Meet Stories 🐾 💕 Say hello to Stories, a sweet and affectionate girl who's ready to begin her next chapter—with you! This friendly lady is a total social butterfly who gets along beautifully with both dogs and cats. She’s always happy to make new friends and brings a gentle, joyful energy wherever she goes. Stories loves her toys 🎾, adores her treats 🍖, and soaks up affection like sunshine ☀️. Whether she’s having a play session or just leaning in for cuddles, she’s happiest when she’s close to her humans. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s good with all creatures and full of fun and affection, Stories could be the perfect addition to your family. Let her bring some love—and a few tail wags—into your life!

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Meet Daisy 🌸🐾 She is a gentle and loving girl who’s ready to find her forever home. With her soft nature and kind eyes, Daisy will quickly win your heart. This lovely girl gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes, and she’s a great little traveller—calm and content on car rides. She also walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls with her a breeze. Daisy can be a bit nervous in new environments, so she’s looking for a quiet, calm home 🏡 where she can feel safe and settle in at her own pace. Once she’s comfortable, she truly shines—especially when there are pats and cuddles on offer. She's a sweetheart who just needs a little time and a lot of love. 🌼

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Say Hello to Sam 🐶 Meet Sam, a sweet and easy-going boy with a playful heart and a gentle soul. This chilled-out pup is looking for a loving home where he can share his big heart—and maybe a few treats! Sam is fantastic with children and gets along well with other dogs, making him a great fit for a family home. Whether he's lounging around or engaging in a game, Sam is happiest when he's with his humans—no matter their size! He’s got a playful side and loves to be involved in the fun, but he also enjoys a nap in a sunny spot. Treats are a big motivator for this handsome guy, and his friendly, happy nature makes him a joy to have around. If you're looking for a relaxed but playful companion who gets along with everyone and loves being part of the family, Sam might be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Zane
TEXT: Say hello to Zane! 🐾 Say hi to Zane, a lovable boy with a bright personality and a constantly wagging tail! Zane is the kind of dog who takes life in stride—always happy, always friendly, and ready to make new friends wherever he goes. Zane gets along beautifully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether he’s meeting other Greyhounds or mingling with different breeds, he’s calm, polite, and loves being part of the action. Busy environments? No problem for Zane! He takes everything in with a relaxed attitude and copes well with new places, people, and experiences. He’s curious, confident, and always up for a new adventure—especially if there are treats involved (his favourite!). Zane would thrive in a home where he gets to be part of the fun and share his joy with others. If you’re after a gentle, friendly companion who brings sunshine wherever he goes, Zane might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Chloe
TEXT: Meet Chloe — the confident, friendly tail-wagger who loves her doggy pals! 🐾💖 Chloe is a happy-go-lucky greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger tail — because she just can’t stop wagging when she’s around other dogs! 🐕💨 She already lives with a small dog and absolutely loves having furry friends to share her days with. With her confident and friendly personality, Chloe is always ready to say hello, make new friends, and spread good vibes wherever she goes. Whether she’s meeting new pups on a walk or chilling at home with her canine buddy, she’s a true social butterfly. 🦋🐶 If you’re looking for a cheerful, outgoing greyhound who adores company and knows how to make friends easily, Chloe is the perfect match!

NAME: Garth
TEXT: Introducing Garth… 🐾✨ Garth is a clever, confident greyhound who is happy to sniff out the world around him. 🌍👃 Whether it’s a leafy park, a busy street, or a quiet trail, Garth’s nose is always on a mission. He’s got a serious sniff game going on, taking in all in. But don’t let his independent streak fool you — when it’s time to wind down, Garth transforms into a total cuddle champ. 🥰 He’s a pro at snuggling up close, giving the best warm, cozy vibes after a long day of exploring. 🐕❤️ On walks, Garth is the perfect gentleman: calm, focused, and walking nicely on the lead. 🐕‍🦺 He’s happy to take the lead on where to sniff next, but always by your side. If you’re after a smart, easy-going companion who loves his independence but knows how to share the love, Garth is your guy and he can’t wait to meet you! 💙

NAME: Canya
TEXT: Canya is a cute guy, happy to settle where ever and go with the flow. He walks nice on lead, happy around new people and happy wagging tail where ever he goes. Canya would enjoy an outdoor area to call his home whether that's a courtyard or backyard. Super friendly and easy going, Canya would happily join a family with children or other dogs. He will lean on you and be forever grateful and love you forever for the adventures and treats that come his way! Canya is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sadie
TEXT: Say hello to Sadie! 🌸 Sadie is a cool, calm, and confident greyhound who knows exactly what she wants out of life — and that includes plenty of chill time 😌. She’s an independent lady who’s perfectly happy entertaining herself with a comfy bed 🛏️, a toy or two 🎾, and a quiet corner to call her own. She would suit a household with full time workers or with another chilled out dog. Relaxed and self-assured, Sadie takes new experiences in her stride. If you're looking for a low-maintenance companion who brings a calm presence and quiet charm into your home, Sadie could be the perfect fit 🐾💕

NAME: Shakey
TEXT: Meet Shakey! 🐾 Shakey is a lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection for humans and fellow dogs alike❤️. Always the initiator of cuddles and belly rubs, Shakey thrives on connection and companionship. Curious and adventurous, he loves exploring new surroundings and enjoys every walk — especially because he’s such a pro on the lead! 🚶‍♂️ He’d be happiest in a busy, lively home where there’s plenty going on and would be more than happy with another furry friend to share the fun 🐕🎉. If you’re looking for a gentle, sociable, and well-mannered greyhound to brighten your days, Shakey might just shake her way into being your perfect match!

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful dog who enjoys his days lazing around the backyard with his two older female greyhound friends. Max is smaller sized for a male weighing only 29kg Max is a great companion and would be perfect for a family with another large dog for him to be friends with. Max has been socialised around younger school age children and happily plays in the backyard with them. Max would make a great addition to your home and is perfect for full-time workers with a companion to hang with during the day

NAME: Tommy
TEXT: Meet Tommy – The Tail-Wagging Bundle of Joy! 🐾🎉 Tommy is a happy greyhound whose tail never stops wagging! He’s a lovable guy who thrives on cuddles, pats, and playtime—always ready to share his infectious enthusiasm with everyone he meets. Tommy loves exploring new places and sniffing out adventures, making every walk an exciting journey. His joyful spirit and affectionate nature make him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a fun-loving, loving friend. If you want a happy, playful pal who’s always up for a cuddle and a romp, Tommy’s your guy!

NAME: Spook
TEXT: Meet Spook – Your Loyal, Cuddly Companion 🖤🐾 Spook is a gentle greyhound with a loving heart and a soft spot for cuddles. He gets along beautifully with both cats and dogs, making him a great addition to a multi-pet home. Spook would be perfectly suited to a retired person or someone who works from home—he loves having company and will happily curl up beside you while you go about your day. Calm, affectionate, and easy to please, Spook’s happiest moments are spent close to the people he loves. If you're after a quiet, cuddly companion who’ll be your shadow in the best way, Spook is ready to find his forever home with you.

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Meet Alfie! 🐾 Alfie is a handsome greyhound with a heart as big as his paws! This sociable guy adores the company of humans and loves making new friends—especially the big dog kind! With his bubbly personality and relaxed nature, Alfie is the perfect companion for a family looking for a gentle, easy-going friend. He’s fantastic with children, walks beautifully on the lead, and brings a calm, happy presence wherever he goes. Whether he's lounging in the sun or trotting alongside you on a stroll, Alfie is just happy to be part of the fun. If you're looking for a sweet, social pup with a heart of gold, Alfie’s your guy! 💛

NAME: Ray
TEXT: This handsome boy is a Ray of Sunshine🌤️ Ray is the total package! Social, sweet and confident. He absolutely loves meeting new people and greets everyone like an old friend! Ray walks well on lead and loves to explore, so he wouldn't mind joining you for an adventure. He gets along well with other dogs of all sizes too! So he would'nt mind sharing his new home with a friend or two, pending a meet and greet. If you're looking for a loving companion who will brighten your days, Ray is ready to light up your life! Meet him at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bruiser
TEXT: Meet Bruiser – Big Heart, Bigger Tail Wags! 🐶💕 Don’t let the name fool you – Bruiser is a total softie! This happy-go-lucky boy is bursting with love and has a tail that never stops wagging. He’s always ready to greet you with a smile and a nuzzle, and he thrives on affection from his human friends. Bruiser is full of energy and enjoys his playtime, walks, and any chance to explore the world by your side. He’s been around children aged 8 and up and would do well in a home where he can continue building those bonds – he loves being part of the action! Whether it’s zoomies in the yard or cuddles on the couch, Bruiser brings a joyful spark to every moment. He’d be a wonderful match for an active family or anyone looking for a loyal, loving companion. Ready to meet your new best friend? Bruiser can’t wait to wag his way into your heart!

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Meet Maggie – Your Future Snuggle Buddy! 🐾 Say hello to Maggie, a sweet and gentle greyhound with a heart full of love and legs made for graceful strolls. This lovely girl is as affectionate as they come – she absolutely adores pats, cuddles, and being close to her people. Maggie is a dream on the lead and makes every walk a pleasure. She gets along well with other dogs and would happily share her space with a canine friend. Whether it’s a walk around the block or a cozy nap on the couch, Maggie is content just being near those she loves. While Maggie can be redirected around cats, she still needs a bit more work and supervision in that area, so a cat-free home would be best. If you're looking for a calm, cuddly companion who will melt into your side and brighten your days, Maggie might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a gentle, easy-going boy with a calm and placid nature. He loves a good snuggle but is just as happy doing his own thing or spending time with his people. With a slow introduction, he may get along well with smaller dogs. Sonny is a relaxed companion ready to bring quiet joy to a loving home.

NAME: Inex
TEXT: Say hello to Inex! 🐶 Inex is a playful and independent greyhound who loves nothing more than a good romp around the yard. Whether she's chasing toys or just stretching her legs, outdoor time is her favourite time! She gets along brilliantly with other dogs and is very well-mannered on the lead, making walks with her an absolute pleasure. Inex also has a wonderfully independent streak—she’s happy doing her own thing but still enjoys the company of her people and furry friends. If you’re looking for a confident, fun-loving greyhound who’s easy to walk and great with other dogs, Inex could be your perfect match!

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾 Charlie is a social butterfly who loves spending time with people and gets along great with other dogs. He’s full of energy and can be a bit strong on the lead at first, but he quickly settles into a calm and well-mannered walker once he gets going. Charlie is also a pro traveller—he enjoys van rides and is comfortable on the road, making him a great adventure buddy. If you’re looking for a friendly, outgoing greyhound who’s ready to join you on walks and trips, Charlie is your guy!

NAME: Socks
TEXT: Meet Socks! 🐾 Socks is a gentle and affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his appetite! This food-loving boy is as patient as he is sweet, always waiting his turn with a calm and easy going nature. Whether he’s lounging quietly or greeting new friends, Socks is a total sweetheart who gets along wonderfully with other dogs. His friendly personality makes him a joy to have around, and he’s sure to steal your heart (and maybe a treat or two!).

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a calm, easygoing greyhound who’s as lovely on the inside as he is on the outside. With his gentle nature and relaxed attitude, he settles into new environments quickly and takes everything in his stride. Jack is fantastic with children and other dogs, making him a wonderful family companion. He’s always polite, friendly, and happy to be part of the group – whether it’s a quiet day at home or a walk around the neighbourhood. He walks beautifully on the lead, never pulling or fussing, and is more than happy to stroll along at your side. Jack’s chilled-out personality and kind soul make him a joy to have around. Meet Jack by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Meet Billy – The Quiet Charmer with a Playful Side 🎾🐾 Billy is a gentle, independent greyhound with a lovely calm nature and just the right amount of playfulness. He’s not one to demand constant attention, but he’s always nearby with a quiet presence and a soft heart. Billy gets along beautifully with small dogs and is respectful and friendly in their company. He also enjoys a bit of solo playtime with his toys – give him a squeaky or something to toss around, and he’s one happy hound. This laid-back boy values his own space and is content to relax on his own, making him a great companion for someone who appreciates a more independent pet. He’s the kind of dog who slots effortlessly into your routine without any fuss.

NAME: Greg
TEXT: Meet Greg – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌟🐾 Greg is a sweet and sensitive greyhound with a quietly charming personality. He can be a little shy at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up – and once he does, you’ll see a loving and loyal companion who enjoys being part of the action in his own gentle way. Greg gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company. He walks beautifully on the lead and is a dream to take out and about, always calm and well-mannered. He also travels well in the car, making adventures easy and stress-free. With a little patience and a lot of love, Greg will continue to come out of his shell and show you just how affectionate and easy going he really is. He’s a quiet star who’s just waiting for the right person or family to help him shine.

NAME: Sheila
TEXT: Meet Sheila – A Sweet Soul with a Playful Heart 🐾💖 Sheila is a beautiful greyhound with a gentle nature and a heart full of love. She can be a little shy when meeting new people or exploring new places, but give her a bit of time and patience, and you’ll see her blossom into a joyful, playful girl with the happiest little tail wags. Once Sheila feels safe and settled, her playful side shines through. She loves to run, bounce around, and enjoy the company of her doggy friends – she gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in their company. Sheila would do best in a calm and supportive home where she’s given the space to build her confidence. In return, she’ll reward you with sweet affection, gentle playfulness, and a loyal heart.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny🎾🐾 Penny is a bright, bubbly greyhound with a zest for life and a serious love for fetch! Toss a ball and watch her light up with joy – she could play all day if you let her. Her playful spirit and happy nature make her an absolute delight to be around. Always cheerful and full of personality, Penny brings positive energy wherever she goes. She travels well in the car, making her a great companion for outings and adventures, and she’s perfectly content relaxing in her crate when it’s time to wind down. Penny is the perfect mix of fun and easy going. Whether she’s chasing a ball, enjoying a ride, or snoozing in her crate after a busy day, she does it all with a wagging tail and a happy heart.

NAME: Glen
TEXT: Meet Glen – The Ultimate Companion with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Glen is a handsome greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger love for life. Friendly, affectionate, and full of charm, Glen adores people and never misses an opportunity for a cuddle or a kind word. His tail is always wagging, especially when he's surrounded by his favourite humans. Glen gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is a real social butterfly. Whether he's playing with his pals or just chilling nearby, he brings calm, friendly energy wherever he goes. A big fan of toys, Glen loves a bit of playtime and will happily keep himself entertained with a squeaky or two. He also travels like a dream in the car, making him the perfect buddy for road trips, weekend getaways, or even just a quick drive to the park.

NAME: Donnie
TEXT: Meet Donnie – The Social Butterfly with a Love for Fun! 🐶🎾 Donnie is a happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for a good time! Whether he’s heading out on a road trip or making new doggy friends at the park, Donnie takes it all in stride. He travels like a pro – calm, relaxed, and ready for the next stop on the journey. This playful boy has a soft spot for toys and will happily entertain himself with a squeaky or a tug toy, bringing a smile to everyone around him.
